title: Creative Strategist
description:
**About fonio**
===============

**We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.**

Fonio is Europe’s market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we’re expanding globally and into new products.  
We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.  
Join one of **Europe’s fastest-growing companies**.

**Your role**
-------------

You own the *how we say it*. All day, you concept and script ads: hooks, angles, and narratives that stop the scroll and convert. You work closely alongside the Creative Director, who sets final direction - but day-to-day you run independently. Full ownership over your scripting, no micromanagement loops.

**What to expect**
------------------

* You script and concept paid ads at pace — hooks, angles, storylines
* You own the creative angles for our campaigns and constantly develop new approaches
* You work closely with the Static Ads Designer and Content Creator to turn concept into finished output
* You operate autonomously; the Creative Director sets direction and gives final sign-off
* You test, learn from performance data, and iterate

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

* Experience scripting paid ads (Meta, TikTok, YouTube) with demonstrable performance
* You think in hooks and angles and understand what stops people in the feed
* You produce fast and at volume without sacrificing quality
* Genuinely excited about AI and the space
* Very good English

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary: €65,000–€100,000
* Equity - you're building this, so you should own a piece of it.
* Food & drinks - lunch and dinner are on us at the Vienna office (plus all the drinks you want, and yes, we have protein bars and vitamins too).
* Relocation bonus (if you still need to move to Vienna)
* Equipment of your choice - whatever makes you happy.
* Regular team offsites.

**Hiring process**
------------------

* 15 min intro call
* Case study (take-home)
* 30 min skill interview (walk-through of your case)
* 20 min culture fit

Compensation Range: €65K - €100K

title: Senior Art Director (Beauty, Skincare, Wellness & Lifestyle)
Creative Engineer / AI Creative Technologist
description:
We’re looking for a **Creative Engineer / AI Creative Technologist** to explore what’s possible with the rapidly evolving generative media ecosystem and turn that exploration into exceptional model examples, workflows, and content.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of generative AI, creative technology, and technical storytelling. You’ll work directly with image and video models, experiment with different models and workflows, push them to their limits, and figure out how to consistently get the best possible creative results from them.

You’ll turn that experimentation into compelling examples, workflows, guides, and social content that show developers and creators what is possible with Runware and help us move quickly around new model releases.

We’re looking for someone who is already deeply immersed in generative media — not simply using AI tools, but understanding how models, prompting, pipelines, conditioning, and automation fit together, and knowing how to combine them to produce standout creative output.

**What you’ll do**

* **Experiment hands-on with new generative image and video models**, understanding their capabilities, limitations, and how to get exceptional results from them.
* **Build and refine advanced generative-media workflows**, combining models, prompting techniques, conditioning, automation, and tools such as ComfyUI.
* **Create standout model examples, workflows, demos, and visual content** that demonstrate what developers and creators can build with Runware.
* **Turn technical experimentation into engaging content** for model launches, social media, guides, workflow breakdowns, and other creator- and developer-facing channels.
* **Develop repeatable and automated generation workflows** that make it possible to produce high-quality creative output efficiently and at scale.
* **Stay close to new model releases and emerging techniques**, rapidly testing them and identifying opportunities for compelling content and examples.
* **Work closely with Growth, Product, and Engineering** to surface interesting use cases, support launches, and share insights from model experimentation and the wider generative AI ecosystem.

  
**Requirements**  

* **3+ years of relevant experience** in generative media, creative technology, creative engineering, or a closely related technical field.
* **Advanced experience with ComfyUI or comparable workflow tooling**, with the ability to build sophisticated, repeatable pipelines combining models, conditioning, prompting, and automation.
* **Coding and API experience**, including building custom integrations, scripts, tools, or ComfyUI nodes.
* **Strong knowledge of the generative media model ecosystem**, with practical experience across multiple image and/or video models such as FLUX, Stable Diffusion, Wan, LTX, Hunyuan, Kling, or similar.
* **A strong creative eye and a portfolio of high-quality generative AI work** that demonstrates both technical depth and the ability to get exceptional creative results from models.
* **Strong technical communication skills**, with the ability to turn complex experiments and workflows into clear, engaging content for developers and creators.
* **Ability to work independently and move quickly** in a rapidly evolving ecosystem of models, tools, and techniques.  
    
  **Nice to have**
* + Experience working at a **generative AI model, inference, or developer platform company**.
  + Experience with **model adaptation or fine-tuning**, such as LoRAs.
  + Contributions to **open-source generative AI projects or communities**.
  + Experience **presenting technical or creative work publicly**, through talks, workshops, livestreams, conferences, or similar formats.

  
**Benefits**

We’re a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm, celebrate wins, and enjoy some face-to-face time. We have core hours for cooperative working and calls, but outside of that your calendar is yours. Work the hours that let you perform at your peak while also building a healthy life.

Our release cycles are fast and intense, but they’re followed by real downtime. After big pushes we expect the team to unplug, recharge, and come back ready & stronger than ever for the next leap.

* **Generous paid time off** – vacation, sick days, public holidays
* **Meaningful stock options** – share in the upside you create
* **Flexible hours** – own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks
* **Family leave** – paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time
* **Company retreats** – twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations

title: Creative Director, Visual
description:
**Description**
**Some problems are too important for ordinary thinking.**
How do you change behavior at scale? Build trust when trust is hard to earn? Make something complicated feel simple? Get millions of people to see things differently—and do something about it?
  
  
These are the kinds of problems we work on at ICF Next. The stakes are high. The answers aren't obvious. And the work has to do more than look good.
  
  
We're looking for a
**Creative Director**
who loves that kind of challenge. Someone with a restless imagination, exceptional instincts and the ability to turn a difficult brief into an idea that feels inevitable once you've seen it.
  
  
Someone who knows great creative work doesn't happen by accident. It takes curiosity, conviction, craft and people who care enough to keep pushing.
  
  
**About ICF & ICF Next**
ICF is a global consulting and technology services company working on some of the most pressing challenges facing businesses, governments and communities. From energy and climate to public health, infrastructure and government, our teams bring deep expertise to problems that don't have easy answers.
  
  
ICF Next brings creativity into that equation.
  
  
We're writers, designers, strategists, technologists and creative thinkers working together to help organizations connect with people and move them to action.
  
  
We have the creative ambition of an agency and access to the expertise of a global consultancy. That combination gives us an unusual opportunity: to understand difficult problems from the inside, find the human story and create work that makes a difference in the real world.
  
  
There's no shortage of interesting briefs. The challenge is doing something extraordinary with them.
  
  
**The Role**
You'll lead creative across major client engagements, from the first conversation about a problem to the last detail of the finished work.
  
  
You'll find the idea that makes everything click. Set the visual direction. Push the thinking. Bring writers, designers, strategists and producers together around a shared ambition.
  
  
The work spans integrated campaigns, brand experiences, film, digital, social, experiential and whatever else the idea calls for.
  
  
You'll be expected to have a point of view, make decisions, challenge work that isn't good enough and know when to let a better idea win.
  
  
You'll also help shape the creative culture at ICF Next. Not through speeches about excellence, but through the work you make, the standards you set and the people you help develop.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Find the idea. Get beneath the brief, ask better questions and turn complicated challenges into original, compelling creative concepts.
* Set the standard. Bring a sharp eye, strong art direction and a deep respect for design, storytelling and execution. Care about the big idea and every detail that makes it work.
* Make people care. Take subjects that can be technical, sensitive or difficult to explain and make them clear, relevant and human.
* Think beyond the medium. Lead creative across digital, social, film, video, experiential, paid media, out-of-home and emerging platforms. Start with the idea, not the format.
* Make the team better. Inspire, mentor and challenge creatives. Give useful feedback. Recognize talent. Create the conditions for people to do the best work of their careers.
* Stand behind the work. Present ideas with clarity and conviction. Build relationships with clients. Know how to push without making it personal, and how to protect a strong idea while making it stronger.
* Get it made. Work across disciplines, manage competing priorities and navigate the realities of complex projects without losing sight of what made the idea worth pursuing.
* Stay curious. Explore new tools, technologies and ways of working, including AI, without confusing what's new with what's good.

**Who You Are**
You came up through art direction or design, but you've never thought of yourself as just a visual person.
  
  
You think in ideas. You understand the power of an image, the precision of a line of copy and the way everything comes together to tell a story.
  
  
You have taste. You have opinions. You can explain both.
  
  
You know the difference between a clever execution and a genuinely good idea. You can spot what's missing, see what's possible and help a team get there.
  
  
You're comfortable leading a room, but you listen. You know how to sell an idea without overselling it. And you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves when the work needs you.
  
  
You've worked on difficult briefs, with demanding clients and tight deadlines. You've learned that constraints aren't an excuse for mediocre work.
  
  
Most importantly, you still get excited when something great comes together. You haven't lost the instinct to make it better.
  
  
**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of creative experience in an agency, design studio or comparable environment, including senior-level creative leadership.
* A portfolio that shows exceptional conceptual thinking, art direction, design craft and integrated creative work.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Experience leading creative teams and developing campaigns across multiple channels.
* Strong visual storytelling, strategic thinking and presentation skills.
* The ability to take ambitious ideas from concept through production while managing complex projects, stakeholders and deadlines.

**Why ICF Next**
The problems we work on aren't always easy to explain. They don't always come with glamorous briefs or obvious answers.
  
  
That's what makes them interesting.
  
  
You get to work with people who know their subjects inside out, tackle challenges that affect how people live and make decisions, and bring your creative instincts to places where they're genuinely needed.
  
  
There's room here for big ideas. For unexpected thinking. For the kind of work that makes you proud of what you do.
  
  
**If you believe the hardest problems deserve the best creative minds, we'd like to meet you.**
Show us your work. Show us how you think.
  
  
**Bot and Third-Party Applications**

Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.
  
  
**Working at ICF**
ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.
  
  
We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.
  
  
We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
**Work Authorization and Sponsorship**
All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

To request an accommodation, please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.
  
  
Read more about workplace discrimination rights or our benefit offerings which are included in the Transparency in (Benefits) Coverage Act.
  
  
**Candidate AI Usage Policy**
At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodation that involves the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.

title: Head of Brand & Advocacy
description:

title: Creative Director, Fundraising and Mobilization (Evergreen)
description:
Interested in joining Blue State's Creative Director team? Submit your application here to ensure you're first in line for future opportunities. Please note: this is an "evergreen" job post (i.e. not an active job post), but your expression of interest matters to us. While interviews aren't ongoing, we're excited to connect with talented individuals who share our commitment to Blue State's mission.

If you came across this job via LinkedIn, please note that it is an evergreen role; Linked In does not differentiate, but we prefer to.

**What to know**
----------------

Create compelling campaigns, brands and experiences for causes that matter. In this role, you will work closely with account directors, strategists, designers, writers and analysts to ensure that we're delivering innovative, beautiful and flawless work that exceeds the expectations of the organisations we work with. You will bring creative vision and impactful leadership to nonprofits, advocacy campaigns and brands' social impact teams.

We believe great creative is data and strategy driven, not ego-driven. We're looking for you to collaborate closely with our teams to shape test-worthy ideas that will let the numbers do the talking.

We're interested in the originality, honesty and proven success of your concepts and appeals.

**The company**
---------------

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

**A day in the life**
---------------------

* **Lead and inspire:** Working closely with your colleagues, you'll develop a vision for our client's creative success. You'll guide the development and implementation of campaigns, appeals and creative platforms, from initial presentations through final delivery.
* **Create with purpose:** Organisations come to us with big questions and for direction on how to be more meaningful, relevant and human - your conceptual thinking and messaging will help make that a reality.
* **Accountability:** Assess and ensure the quality of creative process and product on an ongoing basis. Attend internal critiques, and provide creative solutions to team. Final sign-off on design, copy, and UX work for key projects.
* **Foster a culture of collaboration and creativity:** Stay on top of developments in the field, industry, and culture. Help identify, hire and retain designers, copywriters, and other creatives. Mentor junior members of the project team.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Unlimited time off (inclusive of sick, personal and vacation days)
* $1,000 annual in professional development funds (local equivalent)
* Fully subsidised health and dental insurance for employees (subject to tax)
* Generous pension match via salary sacrifice
* Generous paid holiday schedule
* Parental leave policy for up to 32.5 week of coverage at full pay, inclusive of all genders and supporting a range of family structures
* Group Income Protection (GIP)
* Group Life Assurance (GLA)
* Optional holiday travel insurance
* Pre-tax season ticket loans
* Cycle to work (up to £2000)
* Remote work flexibility

We approach in-office working with a hybrid model, with presence in our office required at two days per week.

**The team**
------------

You'll be a senior member of the London team bringing in new clients and, as a leader, defining and improving the work we're creating. You will also be a part of our global creative director team who meet regularly for creative inspiration.

**Some things we're looking for**
---------------------------------

* 6+ years in senior creative role, ideally with hands-on designing experience. At least some of this experience working on fundraising and mobilisation campaigns.

* Experience in leading and collaborating with teams of designers, copywriters, strategists and creatives - taking insight that has been shaped and developing compelling, digitally-driven ideas and products.

* Strategy-led: able to clearly articulate design or strategy related dilemmas, and offer multiple solutions with a clear link back to the strategy and insights.

* Comfort and passion for creative testing, co-creation with clients and audiences, and constructively consolidating feedback from global stakeholders to improve the work.

* Impeccable presentation skills: able to explain the reasons behind a particular design or creative strategy, and guide clients through difficult decision points. Experience in pitching a strong advantage.

* Deep knowledge of persuasion strategies & tools: copywriting, social influence, brand advocacy, fundraising, UX and experience design.

* Strong sense of communications and its operating model: how impactful messages are created, journeys constructed and users driven on a journey from awareness to advocacy.

* An area of expertise or passion in the design world (be it fundraising, design, UX, communications or social change) that you can harness and upskill wider team members with as a thought leader within the wider company.

* Industry-leading quality of work: you produce inspiring work that stands out, is flawless in execution, and innovative in thought. You are both a doer and a thinker, and your work reflects that.

* Patient with your colleagues and clients, able to make key decisions when and where required.

* Ability to adapt to new situations, solve problems on the fly, and communicate with those around you. Teamwork and scrappiness required, alongside respect to our clients and their expertise.

* A shared passion and curiosity for making change. This includes comfort with ambiguity, a restlessness that resists the status quo, and a commitment to quality that ensures we're always making progress.

* A firm grasp on the latest AI tools, the creative and ethical considerations they demand, and a healthy disrelish for written and visual slop.

* Empathy, communication, respect, and the ability to act as a role model at Blue State.

At Blue State, diversity is a necessity, not a nice-to-have. We encourage those from underrepresented communities — women, people of color, LGBTQIA+, immigrants, those with disabilities and people at all the intersections in between — to apply. Even if you don't think your current skill set checks every box, but this role seems to align with your strengths, we want to hear from you.

Blue State is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible application and interview process. If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation for a disability, including the use of AI tools throughout the hiring process, please contact us at recruiting@bluestate.co with the **subject line: Accommodation Request** to get started.

Your privacy is important to us. You can find out more information on how we handle your data for recruiting purposes in our Privacy Policy for Recruitment.

title: Creative Director
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
  
  
**Job Description**
Location:
  
  
London, GB
  
  
Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, CN Traveller, Vanity Fair, Wired, The World of Interiors, House & Garden and Tatler, among many others.
  
  
We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.
  
  
Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday - Thursday).
  
  
We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
  
  
Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.
  
  
Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
  
  
Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high-stakes, multi-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi-market event sponsorships.
  
  
You excel at guiding cross-functional teams through complex, fast-paced workflows, bringing executive-level problem-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.
  
  
Individual & Team Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop bold multi-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.

**Essential Skills & Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre- to post-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production - writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.

**Desired Qualities**

* Culturally informed - Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative - You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail-oriented - Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable - Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically - You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego-less attitude - You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor - You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.

What benefits do we offer?
  
  

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.
* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme, Bupa Private Healthcare, Season ticket loans and eye tests.
* We offer a range of tools to support your wellbeing, including core hours, 10 remote days (from home or a country with a Condé Nast office location), access to our Employee Assistance Programme, corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
* We’re a dog-friendly office, plus you’ll enjoy discounts and magazine subscriptions, keeping you up to date with all things Condé Nast.
* We encourage personal and professional growth through the Condé Nast Learning Hub, where you’ll find an extensive portfolio of learning courses and training available in local languages.
* Our Employee Resource Groups provide a platform for employees to identify shared objectives, exchange ideas, and work on community priorities for our global workforce.

**What happens next?**
If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.
  
  
***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

title: Creative Director
description:
Ibotta is seeking a
**Creative Director**
to join our innovative team and contribute to our mission to Make Every Purchase Rewarding. As Creative Director, you will shape how the world sees Ibotta as a leading technology company, elevating our look and feel across all enterprise marketing and communications while ensuring on-time delivery and efficient operations.
  
  
You will lead our creative studio to develop distinctive brand assets and impactful campaigns that build Ibotta's awareness and grow advertising revenue in the CPG industry. The ideal candidate will bring a blend of strategic thinking, creative excellence, and team leadership to drive our brand's impact and growth. This leader will be expected to have proficiency in design, copywriting, or video production, and will be asked to roll up their sleeves as a practitioner to guide execution and help the team produce exceptional work.
  
  
This position is located in Denver, Colorado as a hybrid position requiring 3 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Candidates must live in the United States.
  
  
**Not based in Denver? We will offer a relocation bonus to help make your move to the Mile High City a smooth one.**
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Build corporate brand identity and creative guidelines for Ibotta to show up visually and experientially across every touchpoint with distinction.
* Lead and mentor a diverse team of creative professionals across design and production, fostering a culture of proven concept, craft, and collaboration while ensuring consistent creative execution.
* Partner closely with product, analytics, marketing, and leadership teams to drive brand consistency and elevate Ibotta's market presence.
* Help translate complex product offerings, data, and value propositions into clean, engaging creative concepts.
* Establish and optimize operational processes to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability of creative output.
* Lead creative reviews, provide actionable feedback, and foster a culture of craft, curiosity, and innovation.
* Serve as a key brand ambassador internally and externally, articulating creative vision and strategy clearly across all levels of the organization.
* Manage team health, resource planning, and talent strategy, ensuring the right capabilities, skills, and staffing are in place to meet business needs.
* Embrace and uphold Ibotta’s Core Values: Integrity, Boldness, Ownership, Teamwork, Transparency, & A good idea can come from anywhere

**What We Are Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience as a hands-on creative with a proven track record across diverse media (agency and in-house). In-house experience is strongly preferred.
* 4+ years of experience leading creative teams in dynamic, fast-growing companies, ideally with a B2B / tech focus.
* A portfolio or sample of work demonstrating excellence in creative direction, brand identity, and multi-channel campaign execution.
* Exceptional leadership and communication skills, capable of influencing cross-functional teams and building strong partnerships across the business.
* Proven track record developing and executing creative strategies that drive measurable business impact.
* Deep expertise across multi-disciplinary creative work with a love for craft and storytelling.
* Proven understanding of multi-channel marketing strategy and how to tie creative initiatives to business goals.
* Confidence in establishing and scaling creative operations and processes in fast-growing environments.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and driving brand transformation in a rapidly evolving landscape.
* Belief in the power of teamwork, transparency, and the notion that a good idea can come from anywhere.

**About Ibotta ("I bought a...")**
Ibotta (NYSE: IBTA) is a leading performance marketing platform allowing brands to deliver digital promotions to over 200 million consumers through a network of publishers called the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN). The IPN allows marketers to influence what people buy, and where and how often they shop – all while paying only when their campaigns directly result in a sale. American shoppers have earned over $1.8 billion through the IPN since 2012. The largest tech IPO in history to come out of Colorado, Ibotta is headquartered in Denver, and is continually listed as a top place to work by The Denver Post and Inc. Magazine.
  
  
**Additional Details**

* This position is located in Denver, CO and includes competitive pay, flexible time off, benefits package (including medical, dental, vision), Employee Stock Purchase Program, and 401k match. Denver office perks include paid parking, snacks, and occasional meals.
* Base compensation range: $145,000 - $170,000. Equity is included in overall compensation package. This compensation range is specific to the United States labor market and may be adjusted based on actual experience. Total compensation for this role also includes a variable component in addition to base salary.

description:

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
  
  
Experience Design Director - EA SPORTS Network
  
  
***Note: This is a hybrid role (on-site work required from Orlando, FL) - Relocation assistance is***
***available for this role.***
Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and
  
  
fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that
  
  
connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are
  
  
invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
  
  
EA SPORTS is one of the leading sports entertainment brands in the world, with top-
  
  
selling videogame franchises, award-winning interactive technology, fan programs,
  
  
and cross-platform digital experiences. EA SPORTS creates connected experiences
  
  
that ignite the emotion of sport through industry-leading sports video games,
  
  
including Madden NFL and College Football , FC soccer, NHL hockey, and
  
  
EA SPORTS UFC .
  
  
**About The Role**
The Experience Design Lead (Creative Director) is the vision-holder for how fans interact with the future of EA SPORTS, reporting to the Sr. Director of EA SPORTS Network. Serving as the design and user-experience anchor of the Network leadership team, this leader is responsible for transforming complex, shared platform and network capabilities into intuitive, memorable, and high-fidelity consumer experiences.
  
  
Rather than focusing on a single franchise or product, this role defines the design principles, reusable experience systems, and connected fan journeys that weave individual games (such as Madden NFL, FC, and College Football) into a cohesive, immersive EA SPORTS ecosystem. This role will be a visionary design leader who can establish and scale the Experience Design function for SPORTS Network, instill a design-centric culture across the team, and champion design innovation in partnership with studios and design partners within EA SPORTS.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Experience Strategy:
  
  

* Ecosystem Experience Vision: Define the long-term, multi-platform vision for a connected EA SPORTS experiences, spanning console, mobile, web, and companion applications.
* Consumer-First Design Principles: Translate strategic growth objectives into high-caliber consumer experience principles that put the fan journey at the center.
* Ecosystem Roadmaps: Author and drive long-term experience design roadmaps that anticipate and support future portfolio growth and platform capabilities.

**Connected Fan Experiences**

* Unified Journeys: Map and refine end-to-end fan journeys that connect multiple EA SPORTS experiences, standardizing how identity, personalization, recognition, commerce, and community are experienced.
* Scalable Design Systems: Establish, govern, and continuously evolve scalable design systems, UI/UX toolkits, and reusable interaction models across the portfolio.
* Preserve Franchise Identity: Balance the need for network-wide experience consistency with the unique, highly branded visual identity of individual sports franchises.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* The Leadership Triad: Partner directly with the Sr. Director of Product Management and Technical Director to build a user-centered development lifecycle where design, technology, and business goals align.
* Experience Workshops: Lead collaborative experience workshops and build alignment around shared consumer experiences across different team boundaries.
* Influence without Authority: Guide design direction and build consensus across disparate teams, studios, and brand partners through collaboration rather than direct authority.

**Experience Innovation & Data Informed Design**

* Emerging Interactions: Explore and prototype next-generation interaction models, including AI-enabled personalization, spatial design, and real-time sports feed integrations.
* Data-Informed Iteration: leverage user research, player data, and run experience design workflows to continuously iterate and elevate experiences.

**Your Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years of experience leading UX, Product Design, Experience Design, or Creative Direction for world-class, large-scale digital consumer ecosystems or entertainment products.
* Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.
* Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.
* Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.
* Tooling & Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.

**About Electronic Arts**
We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
  
  
We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.
  
  
Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

title: Creative Director, Product & Experiences - Flow Studio (Remote)
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
26WD100658
  
  
**Creative Director, Product & Experiences — Flow Studio (Remote)**
Location: Remote US or Canada | Los Angeles area preferred
  
  
Organization: Flow Studio Product
  
  
We’re looking for a
**Creative Director**
to help define what AI filmmaking can become with Autodesk Flow Studio. This is a rare opportunity to shape both the creative direction of the product itself and the films, experiments, demos, and cultural moments that show the world what it can do.
  
  
This is an AI-first, hands-on creative leadership role embedded within the Flow Studio Product organization. You’ll have significant creative freedom, lead a dedicated content team, work closely with Product leadership, and get hands-on with emerging AI filmmaking tools and workflows. The work can range from ambitious cinematic showcases and AI films to fast-moving social experiments designed to earn attention organically.
  
  
You’ll own the creative bar for everything that lives in or represents the product: the creative look and feel of key product surfaces, cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, templates and examples, demos, launch storytelling, and other content that helps creators understand what Flow Studio can make possible.
  
  
You’ll also be the primary product-side creative partner to Flow Studio Marketing, helping shape concepts, promos, launch videos, campaigns, social content, and other external storytelling. Marketing leads audience, campaign, channel, and brand strategy; this role brings the product’s creative vision, AI filmmaking expertise, cinematic taste, and product truth into the work.
  
  
The ideal person is already deeply engaged in AI filmmaking, has exceptional visual taste and a strong cinematic eye, understands internet culture and social trends, and wants the freedom and resources to make ambitious work that people actually want to watch.
  
  
**Please submit a portfolio or reel with your application.**
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Own the creative vision and quality bar for Flow Studio across in-product creative experiences, cinematic content, libraries, demos, showcases, and product storytelling.
* Lead and develop the Flow Studio content team, setting creative priorities, directing execution, mentoring contributors, and building a team capable of producing exceptional work quickly.
* Create and direct ambitious AI filmmaking work—from cinematic showcases and product films to reference-quality experiments that push the creative possibilities of Flow Studio.
* Work hands-on with emerging AI image, video, performance, animation, and filmmaking tools; prototype new ideas, test new models and techniques, and turn experimentation into finished creative work.
* Shape the creative layer of the product itself, including cinematic and animation libraries, camera moves, examples, templates, onboarding content, reusable scene elements, and other creator-facing experiences.
* Bring strong filmmaking judgment to camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, visual treatment, and storytelling across the work.
* Partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering from early feature development through launch, translating new capabilities into compelling creative experiences and demonstrations.
* Act as the primary product-side creative partner to Marketing for launches, campaigns, promotional films, social, web, events, and other external storytelling—helping shape concepts, scripts, storyboards, visuals, and execution.
* Identify opportunities around emerging AI, filmmaking, and social trends, and create culturally relevant, internet-native work that is distinctive, timely, highly shareable, and capable of earning meaningful organic reach.
* Build lightweight creative standards, reusable assets, and production practices that help the team maintain a very high bar without slowing down experimentation.

**Qualifications**

* Exceptional portfolio or reel demonstrating outstanding cinematic taste, storytelling, and creative direction.
* Deep, hands-on experience with AI filmmaking and modern generative creative tools, with a strong understanding of the rapidly evolving image, video, performance, animation, and AI production landscape.
* Strong filmmaking instincts across camera, composition, lighting, performance, pacing, editing, and visual storytelling. Cinematography or directing experience is a major plus.
* Proven ability to originate and create ambitious cinematic work—not only manage or review the work of others.
* Strong understanding of viral, social, and internet-native content, with sharp awareness of emerging social media trends, formats, platforms, and online culture. Demonstrated experience creating or directing work that has earned meaningful organic reach, audience engagement, or cultural traction.
* Experience leading creative teams, giving direct and constructive feedback, and maintaining a consistently high creative bar.
* Comfort working closely with Product and Engineering teams and turning emerging technology and complex product capabilities into compelling creative ideas, demonstrations, and experiences.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Flow Studio develops a recognizable creative voice and a consistently exceptional quality bar across the product, its content, and the work shown publicly.
* New product capabilities become films, demos, experiments, and creative experiences that make people immediately understand—and want to try—what Flow Studio can do.
* The content team becomes a fast, ambitious creative engine that can produce both high-end cinematic work and culturally relevant, internet-native experiments.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About JumpSeat**
JumpSeat is a B2B growth agency and advisory built around a simple belief: the best opportunities rarely come from the obvious signals.
  
  
We help go-to-market teams find the non-obvious signals others miss and turn them into highly relevant outreach that earns a response. It's an antidote to the automated, generic outbound buyers have learned to ignore.
  
  
Our Signal Intelligence methodology combines prioritized accounts, custom signal libraries, AI-assisted research, and 1:1 messaging based on what's actually happening inside a target account, before everybody else sees it.
  
  
We're a remote-first crew across the US and Buenos Aires. We care about bold, ground breaking work, and about the people who make it.
  
  
**The role**
We're looking for a Creative Director to lead our creative department.
  
  
This is more than a creative leadership role. You'll lead the people, the capacity, and the way we work: our two full-time creatives, our freelance bench, and the process that gets great work out the door. You'll partner with our delivery team on priorities, and set the vision and standards for the department.
  
  
You'll stay hands-on too, leading brand, campaign, web, and pitch work.
  
  
And you'll help shape how AI fits into our creative work. That means testing tools, deciding where and when they belong, and making sure they improve both the quality of what we make and the team's experience making it.
  
  
This is a senior role for someone with a proven track record leading creative in a fast-paced agency.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead the department.**

* Manage, mentor, and grow our two full-time creatives. Clear goals, honest feedback, real development.
* Set the creative vision and the way we work, then champion it across the agency.
* Build a team people want to be on, and a culture where the bar keeps rising.
* Bring the creative point of view to leadership conversations about where JumpSeat goes next.

**Run the engine.**

* Own capacity planning. Anticipate resourcing needs proactively and balance the load across the team.
* Know when we need more hands. Find, brief, and manage freelancers who meet our bar and our budget.
* Partner with the delivery team to set priorities, timelines, and scope.
* Keep sharpening the creative workflow, from brief to review to client handoff.
* Be the single point of contact for every creative deliverable. On brand, on time, every time.

**Raise the creative bar.**

* Own the quality of everything we make, across every client and channel.
* Lead brand development work: positioning, messaging, and visual identity.
* Concept and lead campaigns, ABM programs, and digital advertising.
* Oversee website design and development.
* Give clear, useful direction to designers and copywriters.
* Work closely with our strategy and account teams so creative work serves each client's business goals.
* Lead the creative side of new business pitches, from concept to presentation.

**Shape How We Use AI.**

* Experiment with AI tools across ideation, copy, design, and production.
* Decide where, when, and how AI tools and workflows are adopted in our day-to-day, based on one test: does it make the work better, and the work of making it better?
* Set practical guardrails for quality, brand fit, and client trust.
* Help the team build skill and confidence with new tools, and share what works across JumpSeat.

**Who You Are**

* A Creative Director, ACD, or Head of Creative from a strong agency, who has led a creative team directly.
* A department builder, not just a project lead. You've owned capacity, resourcing, and process, and you actually enjoy it.
* A true partner to delivery and account teams. Comfortable trading off priorities, scope, and timelines in the open.
* Experienced at bringing in and leading freelance talent.
* A versatile creative across branding, web, campaigns, and digital advertising, who still wants to roll up their sleeves.
* Quick to understand the unique aspects of a client's industry, culture and voice, so you can hit the ground running.
* Someone who loves growing people, and builds teams that stick together.
* Hands-on with AI tools, and clear-eyed about them. You already use them in your creative work, and you have a point of view on where they help and where they get in the way.
* A clear, confident presenter with existing and new clients.

**Nice to have**

* Fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. Other design tools are a plus.
* B2B experience. Helpful, not required.
* You've led a team through a change in tools or workflows before.

**How We'll Get To Know You**

* A conversation with our Talent team.
* A practical case. You'll present how you'd approach a real-world challenge.
* A conversation with senior team members.

**What's In It For You**

* Real influence. You'll shape a function at the core of our business, and how it works.
* Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.
* Remote first. Colleagues across the US and Buenos Aires.
* Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Fridays, time off between holidays, and more.

**Ready to take the seat?**
If you want to build a creative department, not just fill its pipeline, we want to hear from you.

title: Art Director
description:
**Say hello to Hagerty**  
Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do, and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!  
  
As an **Art Director,** you’ll contribute to Hagerty’s creative output by developing design and concepts that bring the Hagerty brand to life across digital, print, video and event marketing. You’ll collaborate closely with Creative Directors, writers, strategists, and other team members to develop integrated campaigns and presentation decks for business and marketing need. Working as part of a cross-functional creative team, you’ll produce work that is compositionally strong, conceptually driven, and true to our brand’s distinct voice and visual identity. You’re detail-oriented, curious, and eager to grow your craft while contributing to projects that span the full breadth of Hagerty’s creative work.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
***Creative Concept Development***

* Work with Creative Directors and cross-functional teams to build presentation decks for business and marketing needs.
* Develop concepts and campaign ideas for integrated brand and marketing campaigns across channels, including large-scale events and key business initiatives.
* Take campaign platform ideas and develop them into strong, channel-specific creative executions while maintain brand guidelines.
* Produce work that reflects Hagerty’s visual identity and brand voice, including the brand’s signature “twinkle in the eye.”
* Contribute to brainstorming sessions and concept exploration for assigned projects through research and creative development.
* Deliver work on time and communicate with project leaders when timelines are at risk.
* Seek and incorporate feedback from creative leadership with a growth mindset.
* Navigate day-to-day creative challenges by following established processes, seeking guidance from peers and senior team members when unfamiliar situations arise.

***Design Execution***

* Create compositionally strong, thoughtful design work across digital and print mediums using Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma).
* Apply an understanding of graphic design principles including layout, typography, color, and hierarchy to produce effective visual communications.
* Maintain consistency with brand standards and contribute to assigned projects with direction from the Art Director or Creative Director.
* Assist with photo shoot preparation, including contributing to shot lists and asset needs under direction.
* Support pre-flighting and print production processes as needed.

***Collaboration & Brand Stewardship***

* Collaborate with clients, creative leadership, and project teams to understand business objectives and develop appropriate creative solutions.
* Regularly interact with internal clients and stakeholders to ensure work aligns with project goals.
* Stay current on industry trends, popular culture, and emerging advertising techniques; share relevant insights with the team.
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment that encourages creative problem-solving and continuous learning.
* Always keep the member’s point of view in mind when creating, ensuring work resonates with Hagerty’s audience.

**This might describe you**

* A plus if you love cars, the automotive world and are an enthusiast yourself.
* You have experience in an advertising agency or strong in-house creative department, concepting, writing, and producing integrated brand and retail campaigns.
* You can easily build presentation decks in programs like Figma, Keynote, or Power Point.

* A portfolio featuring strong examples of social-first and digital-first work, including paid social, organic social, short-form video or motion, responsive design systems, and platform-specific creative executions.

* Strong conceptual thinking combined with excellent hands-on design and execution skills.

* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign; Figma proficiency is strongly preferred.

* Experience collaborating with or directing motion designers, editors, illustrators, photographers, retouchers, and other production partners.

* Experience working within pharmaceutical medical, legal, and regulatory review processes; annotation and Veeva-submission experience is a plus.

* Strong communication, collaboration, presentation, organization, and time-management skills.

title: Associate Design Director
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Hook is a Creative Production Agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team, and an emphasis on production-led design, we develop creative campaigns, short-form content, and websites for well-known brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet.

  

**WHAT’S AN ASSOCIATE DESIGN DIRECTOR AT HOOK?**

Hook is seeking a hands-on Associate Design Director to join one of our teams.

Associate Design Directors are experienced leaders who use design to exceed client goals, while working within the guard rails of existing brand marketing strategies. They operate alongside creative and motion teams, serving as a client-facing bridge between high-level brand strategy and systematic visual execution. They create robust visual languages and scalable design frameworks that power industry-leading content across static and animated mediums.

They are driven experts with a passion for making premium, ground-breaking work and a commitment to fostering the talents of the employees they collaborate with. They are fearless executors who elevate the work into new creative territories. They’re fundamentalists when it comes to digital design, but approach projects with rational and innovative mindsets, always mindful of how it looks and how it works.

Associate Design Directors are ready for hands-on projects at every stage of the life cycle, from brainstorming creative concepts with the project team and developing original campaigns, to participating in client presentations and ensuring deadlines are met, to building dynamic design systems and overseeing high-volume production rollouts that scale seamlessly across digital, video, print, and emerging platforms.

They have a well-established process for concept development, using visual presentations, storyboards, and mocks to communicate solutions to peers, leadership, and clients. They also excel at translating bold concepts into modular, extensible design systems. With expertise in design tokenization, asset automation, and end-to-end production pipelines, they ensure pixel-perfect, efficient client delivery at scale, always on time and on spec.

While this role would oversee tactical production workstreams, their responsibilities will also focus on strategic and conceptual visual design challenges for national and global brands/campaigns. With an existing design team in place, and opportunities to recruit additional talent, previous experience with team and project leadership within a rapid production environment will be a critical skill. Given the close proximity to marketing clients, being an excellent communicator and an overall joy-to-work-with will also go a long way toward success.

While this role can work from any approved location, this person must have the flexibility to work around PST hours as the team’s clients are based on the West Coast.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Demonstrate a mastery of visual design across design disciplines
* Execute, manage, and govern original, conceptual, and system-driven visual design work in line with agency standards and complex brand design systems
* Build and maintain comprehensive visual design systems, component libraries, and modular toolkits that empower teams to produce high-volume assets efficiently without losing creative fidelity
* Apply design rigor to provide mentorship to cross-functional teams with the goal of accelerating skill progression
* Inspire, oversee, and provide mentorship to design staff with the goal of accelerating skill progression through a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and knowledge sharing
* Fluently speak the language of design with both clients and creatives enabling effective feedback and direction
* Demonstrate emotional intelligence in all meetings and communications
* Work closely with creative staff to ensure design work goes above and beyond the expected
* Maintain and promote internal best practices around modern production design, tool integrations, automated workflows, and standardized asset handoffs
* Model a sense of ownership that elevates the standards and quality of all work achieved by the designers
* Demonstrate an ability to work on multiple projects at the same time while maintaining clear vision of priorities
* Lead projects and oversee a team to ensure that work is client-ready at all phases of their projects
* Manage direct reports to help shape and grow their careers as it relates to their hard and soft skill development

  

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**

* Demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship in design, with expertise working on design solutions as it relates to campaigns and visual systems across multiple platforms
* Expertise in visual design with a deep focus on design systems, component architecture, and multi-channel campaign scaling
* Proven experience leading design streams, multi-format adaptation pipelines, and modular creative rollouts for complex, multi-market campaigns
* Have outstanding communication and presentation skills
* Be imaginative, collaborative, conceptual, and curious
* Have an optimistic outlook toward client revisions, knowing when and how to offer opportunities to push boundaries creatively
* Generate and maintain enthusiasm for ideas within the agency as they move from concept to execution
* Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator) alongside a strong technical understanding of digital production formats, asset optimization, and platform specs
* Mastery of Figma (variables, auto-layout, component libraries, dynamic templates) to build scalable design infrastructure and drive workflow efficiencies
* Additional programs and skills are great to come with (illustration, motion/After Effects, 3D/Cinema 4D)
* Have direct experience—and an enthusiasm for—team leadership and mentorship

  

**WHAT ELSE**

Qualified applicants will include a resume and a link to a portfolio/body of work that demonstrates a breadth of experience.

This is a full-time position that can be hybrid or remote, depending on geographic location. We're a close-knit group of people who love what we do and want to create phenomenal work.

Company benefits include health, dental, matching 401k, paid vacation and holidays, wellness stipends/continuing education subsidies and more.

At Hook we value what makes everyone different, we look for the best talent no matter the background. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are.

We look forward to hearing from you!
