title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**What we're building**
=======================

We're empowering small teams with technology that makes it easier to market and grow businesses. Our current focus is to help consumer brands shift from "workflow automation" to "agent management" within their marketing operations. Shadow is the AI coordination layer — providing shared AI memory, centralized agent control, and model orchestration for marketing teams.

**Why join Shadow?**
====================

* **Product Ownership** You'll ship production code daily and help steer key product and technical decisions.
* **Shape the Engineering Culture** You'll influence how we work—tools, processes, standards, and hiring.
* **Work with Challenger Consumer Brands** Talk directly to customers (CEOs, CMOs, VP's) of fast-growing consumer brands—some doing $80M–$500M in revenue.

**The agency behind the product**
=================================

Shadow is built alongside Darkroom — a performance marketing agency that's been operating for 10 years, employs 100+ people, runs 100+ clients at a time, and has worked with over 1,000 consumer brands. The agency is both our proving ground and our first user, which means the data you build with is real marketing data at real volume from day one — not a synthetic demo.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).**

**The role**
============

You’ll own features end-to-end at Shadow, from the first conversation with a user to the polished screen in production. You’ll design in Figma and in code, and ship it yourself.  
You’ll work forward-deployed. You’ll sit with the subject-matter experts who use Shadow every day, like media buyers, strategists and creatives, to learn how they actually work and where they get stuck. Then you’ll turn what you learn into features that fix it.  
You’ll also keep Shadow feeling like one product. As new features land, you’ll make sure every screen, from dashboards to agent conversations, follows the same system and meets the same bar.

**Core Tech & Tools**

* **Languages & Frameworks:** Python, Node.js, React (TypeScript)
* **Datastore:** PostgreSQL
* **Cloud & Infra:** Google Cloud Platform, Airflow, Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes
* **ML/AI:** LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering

**What you'll do**
==================

* Own features end-to-end: find the problem, shape the solution, then design, build and ship it.
* Embed with subject-matter experts to learn their workflows and challenges firsthand.
* Turn what you learn into product: agent conversations, performance and creative dashboards, the marketing calendar, and whatever comes next.
* Own UI/UX consistency across the whole app. Keep the design system current in Figma and React, and hold every new screen to it.
* Sweat the details, including type, spacing, motion, loading and empty states.
* Prototype fast, in code, in Figma or with AI tools, and put ideas in front of experts within days.
* Invent interaction patterns for agentic work. That means streaming answers, showing the agent’s reasoning, approving changes before they touch a live ad account, and admitting when data is missing.
* Turn dense, multi-channel data into screens a marketer can read in seconds.
* Bring the new Shadow brand into the product, working with our brand partners.

**Must haves**
==============

* Shipped product UI you’re proud of, plus a portfolio or live work that shows both the design and the code.
* Strong React, TypeScript and CSS (Tailwind a plus). You can own a frontend codebase, not just individual components.
* Real visual and interaction design skill: typography, layout, color, motion and micro-interactions.
* Curiosity about how other people work. You can spend a day with a media buyer and come back with the real problem, not just a feature request.
* A systems mindset. You notice when two screens solve the same problem differently, and you fix it.
* Equal comfort in Figma and in your editor, and the judgment to know when to skip Figma.
* Taste for data-dense interfaces. Your dashboards, tables and charts stay calm under a lot of information.
* Daily use of AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, with opinions on how AI products should feel.
* Comfort with ambiguity. You’d rather ship and learn than polish in private.
* Clear writing. You can explain the why behind a design to engineers, experts and non-designers.
* Most people who fit this have 5+ years across design and some experience with frontend engineering.

**Nice to haves**
=================

* Forward-deployed, solutions or customer-facing work, or research with expert users.
* You’ve built a design system that other engineers rely on.
* Data visualization work in D3, Visx, Recharts or hand-rolled SVG.
* Motion work, such as spring animation or Framer Motion.
* Experience with LLM APIs, streaming interfaces or agent products.
* Time spent around marketing, ecommerce or analytics tools, or running ads yourself.

**What we offer**
=================

* **Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every employee exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
-------------------------------

We are an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Head of Marketing

Town Web · HeyGov  
Remote · Full-time contractor

**The Quick Version**

Have you ever seen a company create their own National Holiday as part of its marketing efforts?

We did!

Speaking of silly stuff, we even wrote and produced our own comedic commercial about the real pains that our customers have, and it helped make one of our tools the fastest growing AI tool in the industry!

Ultimately we want our marketing to be funny, human, and memorable, because honestly a lot of the stuff out there in the government industry (which is where we compete) is boring.

Now we're looking for someone exceptionally creative to lead our marketing department — a person with the freedom to take big creative swings and the resources to execute their own.

Our brands — Town Web, HeyGov, and ClerkMinutes — form a suite of tools built specifically for municipal clerks, and each one is crafted to be exceptional at its job. If you're a highly effective, exceptional marketing professional, we'd love for you to apply. Below are more details about who we are and what we're trying to achieve.

Here's a video to tell you more about this role!

**The details**

Who we are

We're a small, bootstrapped company approaching $3M in ARR, competing against large, private-equity-owned firms with far deeper pockets. That's why our marketing has to be exceptional on two fronts at once: creative work that is unique and memorable, and follow-through to match it — multi-channel campaigns, disciplined measurement, and sophisticated execution that turns attention into pipeline.

Our customers are municipal clerks at cities, counties, and municipalities of all sizes. They are busy, under-resourced, deeply practical, and they talk to each other (which as you can guess is why we are emphasising the need to have exceptional marketing!)

We build focused products for the clerk specifically, designed to work together as a suite. ClerkMinutes became one of the most widely adopted tools in its category largely on the strength of marketing that looked like nothing else in this space, and your job is to push that further across the whole portfolio. We run on EOS, and the marketing department's cadence — L10s, quarterly Rocks, scorecards — will be yours to run.

What you'll own

* Strategy and positioning across the portfolio, and the department's EOS operating cadence
* Demand and revenue — building a qualified pipeline for Sales through targeted campaigns and similar initiatives. This is how success is measured.
* Full-channel execution — conferences, webinars, direct mail, PR, and outbound alongside digital and paid. Clerks trust people who show up in person, so you will too.
* Lifecycle marketing — from first touch through trial to customer, along with the tech, tracking, and attribution behind it
* The quality bar — you're the final day-to-day reviewer on copy, design, campaigns, and launches
* Go-to-market with Product and Sales — new product launches and targeted campaigns that get us early beta testers, help build awareness for product pilots, and than formal product releases.

Who does well here

Isn’t it clear we’re looking for somebody extremely creative and ambitious!? Are you “THE ONE?”

We’re looking for a creative strategist and an enthusiastic builder who can lead the team from the front line. Think of a special-forces team leader: they plan the mission, and when it's time to move, they're also the first one through the door. That's the posture this role needs — you set the strategy, and then you're in the weeds executing it right alongside the team.

And there is a team. You'll work directly with our copywriters, internal product managers, the sales team, and the people who handle data connection and attribution through Salesforce and our other marketing tools. You'll have a team around you, but want to be clear: we’re not looking for a “manager of managers”.

AI tools like Claude or Codex are part of your daily workflow, and you rely on them to get competent quickly in unfamiliar territory, whether that's GEO, GA4, or something we haven't thought of yet. You also know how to work with a highly creative founder: turning a lot of ideas into focused priorities, pushing back when something won't work, and making sure the good ones actually ship.

This role suits someone who's comfortable working without a finished playbook, and who would rather be in the work than above it.

What we need to see

* Exceptional Enthusiasm
* Extremely Creative Energy
* You've led a marketing function and been accountable for its results
* You've made a traditional or crowded category stand out with ideas of your own
* AI is central to how you work, and you're comfortable enough with code to build or fix small things yourself
* Real paid acquisition experience across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and Bing, and you can run SEO and GEO by directing AI tools well
* Hands-on experience with direct mail, paid ads, conferences, PR, or other high-attention channels, and you're happy traveling to meet clerks and work conferences alongside Sales
* B2B SaaS background, and you've managed employees, contractors, and agencies

Nice to have: GovTech or public-sector experience, marketing more than one product at a time, and building measurement where little existed. EOS familiarity helps too!

How to apply

* Complete the Workable Form, and make sure to include your resume.
* There will questions to answer. Please make sure you answer them- we read these!

  
**Requirements**  
  
**IMPORTANT**

* Only applications submitted through the proper channel, which is Workable, will be processed.
* Taking the CultureIndex Survey is a requirement, we will not respond to any applications submitted without this.

description:
**About Thunes**

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway to move money around the world. Thunes' proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes' Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets, stablecoin wallets and bank accounts worldwide, as well as 15 billion cards via more than 220 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay HK and many more.

Thunes' Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house SmartX Treasury System and Fortress Compliance Platform, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivaled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments, globally. Members of Thunes' Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 14 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, Hong Kong, Johannesburg, London, Manila, Nairobi, New York, Paris, Riyadh, San Francisco and Shanghai. For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

**Context of the role**

We are seeking a highly analytical and forward-thinking **Marketing Tech, Ops & AI Manager (Singapore or Barcelona or London)** to architect, scale, and optimise Thunes' global marketing engine. Reporting to the Director of Demand Generation, you will have end-to-end strategic ownership of our global MarTech stack, customer data platform and revenue attribution.

Crucially, you will serve as the department's AI Champion, embedding artificial intelligence across the board to revolutionise how we plan, research, enrich data, and execute campaigns. You will work as a high-leverage strategic partner to our digital marketing, content, SDR, events, and sales leadership teams worldwide.

**Key Responsibilities**

* AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Design, test, and implement advanced AI prompts and multi-step automated workflows (using Clay, Zapier, OpenAI APIs) to automate manual research, scale lead generation, and continuously find time-saving efficiencies for the broader marketing team.
* AI-Powered Data Enrichment & Mining: Lead advanced data mining and account matching strategies. Leverage predictive AI and lookalike data models within 6sense and programmatic workflows in Clay to discover, enrich, and segment target segments and Ideal Customer Profiles globally.
* Global SDR Tactical Support: Partner with the SDR Manager to supercharge the outbound engine. Deliver hyper-targeted, AI-enriched account lists and custom personalisation hooks to maximise SDR outreach efficiency and monitor call metrics using Gong AI analytics.
* Inbound Engine Optimisation: Monitor and optimise inbound lead flows and internal tech stack integrations, instantly diagnosing errors or data friction to ensure strict SLA compliance for sales hands-offs. Support our digital marketing campaigns, helping to ensure they are highly effective and delivering on the KPIs targets set.
* Data Analytics & Full-Funnel Revenue Attribution: Own the data connection between marketing activities and revenue. Utilise Dreamdata and Salesforce Sales Cloud to track multi-channel ROI (including digital media, SEO, GEO, content, email and major global events). Lead campaign tracking of all key marketing programmes, leveraging tools like Dreamdata to ensure our tracking methodology and resulting data are accurate for full-funnel reporting. Carry out advanced data analysis using AI, spreadsheets and other tools.
* Lifecycle & Campaign Automation: Own and optimise global email nurture and lifecycle tracks within Salesforce/Pardot, Apollo and Gong, ensuring data quality, progressive scoring, and rigorous compliance routing across our international customer database.
* Cross-Functional & Event Support: Provide technical and data support to the Events team by building targeted list segments, structuring multi-channel pre/post-event email nurtures, and maximising database conversion metrics.
* Internal Comms Architecture: Streamline internal marketing performance reporting, building automated summaries and dashboards to keep global, cross-functional stakeholders updated on key marketing wins and pipeline velocity.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales, Revenue Ops stakeholders to define and implement MarTech infrastructure with AI mechanisms and capabilities for Global Marketing that enhance lifecycle customer experience, engagements, campaigns, and retention across prediction markets.

**Professional Experience and Qualifications**

* Professional Experience: ~5-8 years of dedicated experience in Marketing Technology & Operations, Marketing Analytics or Revenue Operations role, strictly within B2B technology or fast-scaling Fintech organisations.
* AI & Advanced MarTech Stack Mastery (Essential): Proven hands-on experience building complex logic, API webhooks, and AI prompt workflows, using Clay, Zapier, 6sense, Apollo, Sales Force, Pardot, Gong, Tableau, Gemini, Claude and Google Apps Script.
* Salesforce Ecosystem Expertise: Demonstrated mastery of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot), including an in-depth understanding of database synchronisation, custom object mapping, system integration and reporting capabilities.
* Data & Attribution Literacy: Exceptional data analysis skills; comfortable handling raw data exports and working with multi-touch attribution platforms like Dreamdata to measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and support data-driven decisions.
* Communication: Fluent spoken and written English. Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly translate technical data/AI workflows into actionable business recommendations for non-technical team members. Ability to work collaboratively and effectively with different teams, sales, product and engineering etc.
* Mindset: Highly organised, detail-oriented, and inherently curious. You are someone who views a repetitive manual task as a problem that must be automated using AI.

*Sound like you? Apply now!*

* Accountable for implementation of new processes, systems and learning, including new ways of working.

* Prioritizes risk mitigation strategies and effective trouble shooting.

* Line manages a team of safety physicians and / or scientists.

* Maintains up-to-date knowledge of the relevant safety scientific literature, and is able to clearly communicate key impactful information,

* Accountable for proper data collection and interpretation for determination of the risks and inform the label in markets globally

* Delivers analyses of clinical safety data in a balanced and statistically robust manner, to drive interpretations and develop novel proposals.

* Serves as a source of scientific and clinical safety knowledge for the Product Team, in the analyses and interpretation of scientific and clinical safety data.

**You will need to have:**

* Medical degree or equivalent degree in biomedicine or science

* 5 years extensive relevant clinical, safety and risk management experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO industry, academia or Health Authorities

* Proven track record of successful clinical safety delivery with demonstrated examples of strategic influence to clinical studies/programs.

* Ability to collaborate across a matrixed environment and influence cross-functional- leaders on decision-making (e.g. Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs).

* Thorough knowledge and understanding of pharmacovigilance & safety deliverables, standards and processes at a global level; including pre and post launch experience.

* Demonstrated ability to successfully lead, coach, and mentor other safety medical directors/scientists.

* Available to travel domestically and internationally

* Demonstrated ability to present complex topics to senior leaders at safety and development governances for alignment and endorsement.

* PhD (or other complementary degree) in scientific discipline.

* Excellent, independent judgment based on leading-edge knowledge and expertise.

description:
***Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance***

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

***Innovate with Tether***

**Tether Finance:** Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, **USDT**, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

**Tether Power:** Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

**Tether Data:** Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like **KEET**, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

**Tether Education**: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

**Tether Evolution**: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

***Why Join Us?***

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

**Are you ready to be part of the future?**

**About the job**

We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.  
  
You will:  

* Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
* Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
* Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
* Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
* Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

  

* Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

* Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
* Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.
* Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.
* Experience working with a remote team
* Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.
* Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

**Important information for candidates**  
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

* **Apply only through our official channels.** We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
* **Verify the recruiter’s identity.** All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
* **Be cautious of unusual communication methods.** We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
* **Double-check email addresses.** All communication from us will come from emails ending in **@**tether.to **or @**tether.io
* **We will never request payment or financial details.** If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

**When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.**

title: Product Manager
description:
**CapsLock** builds exceptional marketing solutions for large partners in the home improvement industry. We don’t just advertise our clients’ products or services - we build long-term marketing solutions within the context of permanent partnerships.

Our people are the backbone of everything we do and are our most valuable asset. Our business model demands top talent across the board, and we aim to create conditions that attract and retain the best individuals globally.

**﻿Role Overview**

We are expanding our Product team, and this role owns a slice of the internal product ecosystem our teams run the business on.

Your starting focus is the Media Buyer Automation Platform — the rules engine, pacing logic, spend controls, alerting, and workflow tooling that let a small team of buyers manage budgets that would otherwise require significantly more headcount. From there, your scope extends across the internal tools that support the wider acquisition engine: marketing automation, reporting and analytics workflows, creative operations, and the new tooling we build as the business shifts. We expect the exact portfolio to evolve, and we are hiring someone who wants that rather than someone looking for a single fixed product.

This is a hands-on builder role rather than a coordination role. Your users are colleagues, the feedback loop is short, and your work shows up in CPA, ROAS, wasted spend, and hours returned to the team. You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with Engineering, Data, Media Buying, Creative, and Operations.

**Responsibilities**

**﻿**

**﻿1. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the end-to-end roadmap for the Media Buyer Automation Platform, including discovery, prioritization, specifications, delivery, adoption, and iteration.
* Take on additional internal products as the portfolio grows, sequencing work across marketing automation, reporting and analytics, creative operations, cross-platform account management, and data reconciliation while maintaining focus on the core platform.

**2. User Needs & Automation**

* Work closely with media buyers to understand their workflows and translate their operational needs into reliable automation for budget pacing, anomaly alerts, spend guardrails, bulk actions, and approval flows.
* Identify manual processes that are consuming capacity across the business and evaluate whether they should be automated through internal development, external solutions, or left unchanged.

**3. Product Development & Delivery**

* Write clear product specifications that engineers can build from, including edge cases, failure modes, rollback behavior, and a defined bar for completion.
* Prototype ideas and build lightweight automations where this can accelerate alignment or address smaller workflow needs without relying on the engineering roadmap.

**4. Adoption, Measurement & Collaboration**

* Drive product adoption through onboarding, enablement, documentation, and continuous feedback loops that ensure tools remain actively used and valuable.
* Define and track meaningful product metrics, ensuring they are properly instrumented and visible, while partnering with Data on event taxonomy, attribution challenges, and measurement trade-offs.

**5. Experimentation & Optimization**

* Run experiments and staged rollouts to validate changes, particularly for functionality that affects advertising spend, before deploying them across full budgets.
* Continuously evaluate and iterate on products based on performance data, user feedback, and evolving business needs.

  
Requirements:
  

* 4+ years in Product Management, with 2+ years owning data-heavy or workflow-heavy products end-to-end.
* Proven track record of building internal or B2B tools for colleagues and driving high adoption.
* Skilled in KPI design, event taxonomy, dashboarding, and turning numbers into decisions.
* Active use of AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Lovable, n8n, custom scripts) to build prototypes and automate workflows. *(Examples will be requested).*
* Practical understanding of LLM limitations, probabilistic feature evaluation, and fallback logic.
* Comfortable running multiple workstreams at once and making confident calls on what to ship first.
* Strong track record of launching small, frequent releases rather than big-bang updates.
* Excellent written/verbal English—creates clear specs, explicit trade-offs, and transparent status updates.
* Experience collaborating effectively across global time zones.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with paid acquisition platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok), rules engines, budget pacing, or creative testing workflows.
* Computer Science, Computer Engineering degree, or experience managing complex SaaS products with multi-platform API integrations.
* Hands-on experience with A/B testing frameworks, feature flagging, or staged rollout systems for spend-affecting logic.

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

**Remote Work**

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

**Senior Backend Engineer (Python)**

**Who is Parser?**

Technology alone does not create impact - the right teams do. Founded in 2018, Parser is a boutique technology services and consulting firm helping global organisations solve complex business challenges through digital transformation, product development and AI enablement.

We are a fast-growing team of 340+ engineers and consultants across Europe (UK, Spain, Portugal), the Americas (US, Argentina, Uruguay, Colombia), and the Middle East. Our expertise spans software engineering, AI & data, product development, and customer experience, delivered by teams that combine strong technical depth with a consulting mindset.

**Why Join Us?**

If you are looking for a place where you can think beyond execution, take true ownership of outcomes, influence decisions, and continuously learn alongside top-tier specialists in a truly global environment, we’d love to meet you.

**How will you impact?**

Parser is looking for an experienced AI and Backend Engineer to join a client delivery team working on Search with one of the largest multinational retail companies, primarily known as a supermarket chain.

  

You will help build AI-enabled tools that help Search teams find problems, test changes and measure relevance more quickly, all built on a shared data foundation. The role combines strong Python backend engineering with hands-on Generative AI experience, and you should be comfortable moving from a working prototype on real data to a production release.

You will make practical decisions about quality, cost, latency and risk, and recognise when deterministic rules, statistical thresholds or traditional machine learning are a better answer than an LLM. We are looking for someone who works collaboratively, shares progress early and focuses on solving real user problems rather than applying technology for its own sake.

**Your key responsibilities:**

* Design and build AI-enabled features that turn search behaviour, diagnostics and quality data into prioritised, actionable insights, using LLMs where they add value
* Build backend services and APIs for tools that collect and combine human relevance judgements
* Turn the existing offline evaluation tool into on-demand environments that developers can run in the CI/CD pipeline
* Define and automate checks on the accuracy and reliability of AI features, including LLM-based relevance judgements
* Work with product, design, data science and Search colleagues to turn prototypes into production releases
* Integrate with existing client platforms and APIs, monitor quality, latency and cost, and document decisions and trade-offs

  

**How you'll work**

* Share work early through documentation, demonstrations and incremental pull requests
* Own deliverables within agreed architecture and engineering practices, and communicate decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly
* Work closely with Search and data science colleagues to assess the quality of AI-generated outputs

* Experiment quickly, test assumptions against real data and iterate using evidence
* Balance exploration with delivery, and avoid unnecessary complexity early on

* Design for trust, clarity and adoption by the people who use the tools
* Recognise when deterministic rules, traditional machine learning or human review are more appropriate than an LLM

  

**What you'll bring to the role:**

**Generative AI and applied machine learning**

* Hands-on experience building LLM applications in production, including prompt design, structured outputs and API integration
* Understanding of embeddings, semantic search and hybrid retrieval, and their trade-offs against lexical search
* Ability to compare models and approaches on quality, latency, security and cost

**Evaluation and reliability**

* Experience building offline evaluations and benchmarks with labelled datasets, and using LLMs as judges calibrated against human labels
* Understanding of ranking metrics such as nDCG, Precision at K and MRR, and of inter-rater agreement
* Awareness of hallucination, bias, drift and privacy risks, and experience designing human review

**Data and platform engineering**

* Strong SQL skills and experience with large analytical datasets
* Familiarity with medallion architectures and integrating AI with data pipelines and APIs

**Software engineering**

* Strong Python skills, including maintainable backend services and APIs
* Good testing discipline across application, data and AI components
* Experience with CI/CD, containerisation and cloud infrastructure, ideally Microsoft Azure

**Qualifications**

* Five or more years of professional experience across software engineering, data engineering, machine learning or applied AI
* Demonstrated experience delivering AI-enabled systems beyond isolated proofs of concept
* Proven ability to ship iterative, user-focused solutions with appropriate attention to reliability and safety
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical choices and evaluation results to non-technical stakeholders
* A collaborative approach to multidisciplinary product delivery

**Nice to have**

* Experience in retail or ecommerce search, including product taxonomy and long-tail queries
* Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch or another production search platform, or with a vector database
* Experience building offline evaluation or A/B testing tooling for search or recommendation
* Experience building human annotation or rating tools
* Experience with event streaming (for example Kafka) or clickstream and web analytics data

  

**Location:** **Spain,** flexible remote work

**You will receive:**

* The chance to join an organization with triple-digit growth that is changing the paradigm on how software products are built.
* The opportunity to form part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.

title: Logistics Manager
description:
**About Carl Friedrik**

Carl Friedrik is a leading premium travel goods and luggage brand, renowned for our exquisite craftsmanship, innovative design, and unwavering commitment to quality. Our products are inspired by the art of travel, catering to discerning customers who seek both style and functionality. We travel differently, inspiring us to ‘Carry with Confidence’.

The Logistics Manager owns inbound logistics: getting our products from our factories to our warehouses in the UK, the EU and the US, on time and at the right cost. You will manage our freight forwarders day to day, liaise with supplier around the world and report on inbound lead times and costs. This role is vital to the success of the company, you will report to the Head of Operations and will work closely with the production teams and warehouses to ensure KPIs are consistently met.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage inbound shipments from our factories to our UK, EU and US warehouses, from collection to booked-in stock.
* Get quotes, book freight with our forwarders and choose the right mode for each shipment's timing and cost.
* Work with Supply Chain on production readiness, collection dates and container loads.
* Book delivery slots with our warehouses and make sure goods are received and booked in on time.
* Track every shipment and flag delays early to Supply Chain and Operations.
* Manage customs clearance, duty and import documentation, including HS classification, commercial invoices and packing lists.
* Report monthly on inbound lead times by route and forwarder: factory-ready to collection, transit, and arrival to booked-in stock.
* Find savings through tenders, renegotiations and better consolidation of shipments.

  

* 3+ years in inbound or international logistics, ideally in e-commerce, direct-to-consumer or retail, including managing freight forwarders.
* Hands-on experience with sea, air and road freight, incoterms and customs, especially UK–EU and US imports.
* Confidence negotiating with forwarders and holding them to quoted costs and transit times.
* Strong numbers skills: you can build a cost and lead time reports using spreadsheets.
* Strong organisational skills, with an ability to manage multiple tasks and work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills - you will liaise internally and externally across multiple departments.
* Curious and proactive - you enjoy digging into processes, spotting where things can be better, and following through on improvement.

**Instrument Licensing Solutions and Patient & Site Strategy** helps organizations understand how patients feel and function in clinical research and routine care. The team develops and manages the instruments used to capture patient experience, oversees permissions and licensing, and guides the evolution and integration of patient- and site-facing technologies with electronic health records.

  
  

**Patient Science, Instrument Development and Thought Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------------

Patient Science, Instrument R&D and Thought Leadership develops new clinical outcome assessment instruments and expands or enhances existing instruments, with emphasis on priority therapeutic areas and market gaps. Drawing on deep expertise in instrument development, scientific consulting, and delivery, the team supports client engagements in collaboration with Patient and Clinical Technology (PACT), IQVIA Laboratories, digital-measure scientists, imaging-measurement scientists, COA managers and therapeutic-area centers of excellence. The team also advances thought leadership through white papers, peer-reviewed publications, books, posters, and podium presentations, working closely with clients, regulators, patient advocacy organizations, industry experts, and other stakeholders.

  
  

**Position**

Composite and companion measures represent an important advance in measuring what matters to patients. By integrating multiple sources of evidence, they help move health care and clinical research beyond measures of service utilization toward a more complete understanding of meaningful outcomes.

This role leads the strategic, scientific, and regulatory development of laboratory- and genomic-enabled composite and companion measures in partnership with IQVIA Labs and external partners. These solutions are designed for use by biopharmaceutical and medical-device organizations in clinical trials and real-world studies, as well as by health care professionals in routine clinical practice.

The Senior Director ensures that the patient perspective is rigorously measured and incorporated into drug-development strategy, laboratory and genomic research, clinical outcome assessment endpoint strategy, regulatory submissions, and commercialization through the application of behavioral and measurement science.

  
  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Senior Director Composite Measures Science & Integration leads the design, development, validation, and implementation of scientifically rigorous composite and companion measurement solutions in partnership with IQVIA Labs and external partners. The role supports corporate strategy, client requirements, global clinical trials, real-world research, and patient-facing care by integrating clinical outcome assessments, digital measures, laboratory and genomic data, and emerging technologies into meaningful endpoints and scalable service offerings aligned with market needs and the IQVIA solutions portfolio.

  
  

**Strategic and Scientific Leadership**
---------------------------------------

Set the strategy, scientific direction, and operating model for Laboratory & Genomic composite and companion measure development.

Partner with IQVIA Labs scientific team and external partners on scientific evolution and market needs.

Assess the feasibility and value of applying measurement science, laboratory methods, digital technologies, and novel data sources to products and services.

Align measurement research and development priorities with corporate strategy, business objectives, client needs, regulatory expectations, and market dynamics.

Maintain expert knowledge of developments in drug development, clinical outcome assessment, digital health technology, laboratory science, genomics, patient care, and relevant regulatory guidance.

Serve as a recognized internal and external scientific authority and as the primary technical contact for complex, cross-functional contracts and projects.

  
  

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Direct the end-to-end development, validation, integration, and delivery of composite measures that combine laboratory, genomic and other clinically relevant data with patient-reported, clinician-reported and digital outcome data.
* Ensure that COA data collection, digital-measure data, laboratory operations, and associated deliverables meet applicable scientific, quality, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead research design and execution, including validation protocols, analytical methods, technical reports, troubleshooting strategies, and short- and long-term project goals.
* Oversee the evaluation and validation of relevant laboratory measurement instruments and methods, including installation, operational, and performance qualification documentation, as appropriate in collaboration with IQVIA Labs and external partners.
* Ensure the high-quality, timely delivery of clinical research and health care solutions while maintaining exceptional standards of client service.
* Use performance indicators, process analysis and AI to improve efficiency, scalability, cost control, resource utilization, and readiness for growth.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives and collaborate with therapeutic-area experts, consulting teams, regulators, clients, patient advocacy organizations, industry thought leaders, technology partners, and other stakeholders.

**Innovation, Publications, and Partnerships**
----------------------------------------------

* Translate scientific and technological advances into differentiated service offerings for clinical research and patient-facing care.
* Advance scientific literature and industry dialogue through peer-reviewed manuscripts, abstracts, posters, podium presentations, white papers, books, patent applications, and scientifically accurate marketing materials.
* Lead or support the development of intellectual property, vendor agreements, research collaborations, and strategic partnerships.
* Identify proactive client solutions that create scientific value, strengthen market differentiation, and support sustainable revenue growth.
  

  

**People and Operational Leadership**
-------------------------------------

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team through effective recruitment, onboarding, training, mentorship, performance management, and succession planning.
* Foster a unified culture of collaboration, information sharing, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and manage operating budgets, resource plans, cost-control standards, and capacity strategies.
* Partner with Quality Assurance and operational teams to implement effective quality programs, address performance issues promptly, and maintain current procedures and staff capabilities.
* Manage staff in accordance with organizational policies and applicable regulations, including work planning, assignment, professional development, employee relations, and appropriate human-resources actions.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* At least 15 years of relevant experience, including substantial experience in scientific method development, clinical laboratory or drug-development solutions, and people leadership.
* Comprehensive knowledge of scientific principles, measurement theory, method development, drug development, and relevant state-of-the-art instrumentation and technologies.

title: Social Media Lead - SportyTV & Sports Media Brands
description:

----------------------

Sporty Group is a global sports entertainment company, home to leading brands like **SportyBet**, **Football.com** and **SportyTV**. We operate at the intersection of **sports, content, community and technology**, building products and media experiences that connect fans with the moments that matter.

Our media brands, led by **SportyTV**, bring fans closer to the game through highlights, stories, analysis, personalities and football culture, across every major social platform.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We're looking for a **Social Media Lead** to drive social strategy and coordinate the social team behind **SportyTV and our sports media brands**. This role combines **team leadership**, a **sports journalism mindset** and **strong editorial judgement** to make our channels a go-to destination for football fans.

You'll set the editorial direction, run day-to-day publishing operations, and lead a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators, making sure our output is **fast, accurate, engaging and built for growth**.

You'll work closely with **Content, Video/Production, Design, Brand, Marketing, Partnerships, BI and Country teams**, and report to the Social Media Director.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Team Leadership & Coordination**

* Lead, coordinate and develop a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators across SportyTV and our media brands.
* Set priorities, assign coverage and run workflows and shift planning for match days, live events and breaking news.
* Give clear feedback, run regular editorial meetings and raise the team's creative and editorial standards.

* Lead real-time and reactive coverage of match days, breaking news, transfers, controversies and trending moments.

### **Content & Formats**

* Oversee content across Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube (incl. Shorts), LinkedIn and Telegram.
* Develop and scale repeatable content series and franchises: highlights-led narratives, analysis, interviews, explainers, football culture and personality-led formats.
* Work with video, production and design teams to deliver platform-native content with strong hooks and retention.

* Work with presenters, journalists, pundits, creators and sports personalities to grow reach and credibility.
* Support partnerships, rights-holder relationships and co-branded activations with clubs, leagues and media partners.

* Track KPIs: reach, views, watch time, engagement, follower growth, retention and sentiment.
* Deliver weekly/monthly reporting with clear insights and next actions for the team and leadership.
* Run testing frameworks to improve formats, hooks, timing and distribution.

**Requirements**
----------------

* **5+ years** of experience in social media, with at least **2 years coordinating or leading social media teams**.
* Background in **sports journalism, sports media or a sports newsroom** (degree in Journalism or Communications is a plus).
* Proven experience running social channels for **sports media brands, publishers, broadcasters, clubs or leagues**.
* Deep football and sports knowledge, with a strong news sense and love for the game.
* **Excellent English (C1/C2 or native)**: you'll write, edit and approve content in English and it's our main working language. Spanish or other languages are a plus.
* Strong editorial judgement: accuracy, fact-checking, tone and handling sensitive stories.
* Excellent platform instincts across TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube and Facebook, and a good understanding of video-first content.
* Confident using analytics and social listening tools to guide decisions.
* Strong organisation, stakeholder management and the ability to lead a team in a fast-paced, high-output environment.

* Experience with live coverage of major tournaments.
* Experience working with audiences in Africa, Latin America or other international markets.
* Hands-on video editing or production experience.

title: Wholesale Assistant
description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

As **Wholesale Assistant** , you will support the Wholesale Manager and Account Executives in the daily management of wholesale operations, ensuring clients receive exceptional service and accurate, timely communication throughout the order lifecycle. The role requires strong coordination across internal departments (Commercial, Operations, Logistics, and Finance) and proactive follow-up with external partners.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**  
  
Support the global Wholesale team in day-to-day account Management, assuring that clients are responded to in a timely manner and given the service needed to support their business.

* Oversee wholesale order management from placement to delivery, ensuring accuracy.
* Monitor order status, deliveries, and resolve logistical issues, aligning with internal teams.

* Coordinate with credit control on payments, invoicing, and blocked orders.

* Assist in onboarding new wholesale clients and manage client databases.
* Support sales reporting, data tracking, and client-facing report preparation.
* Maintain client files, communication trackers, and internal communication logs.
* Support with the management of RTV processes, quality issues, and credit notes.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field.
* At least one year of relevant work experience in a similar role.
* Fluency in both Spanish and English is required; additional languages are considered an asset.
* Strong analytical skills, excellent organisational abilities, and effective time management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
* Previous experience with fashion or luxury brands is a plus, but not essential.

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**
  
  
Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.
  
  
At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

**Job ID** R-261764 **Date posted** 10/16/2026

At AstraZeneca we believe in the potential of our people, and you’ll develop beyond what you thought possible. We make the most of your skills and passion by actively supporting you to see what you can achieve no matter where you start with us.

As Franchise Head your mission will be to lead the correct implementation of the commercial (sales and marketing) strategy and Business Plan, leading your team and ensuring the optimal positioning of your products in the marketplace, in order to improve the quality of life for patients.

The Franchise Head will lead the product' country operations in Spain and will be accountable for achieving revenue and patient acquisition goals. description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie  
Intelligence Connected

**WoodMac.com**

**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**

**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

The Vice President, Head of EMEA Power and Renewables Research will lead Wood Mackenzie's Power and Renewables Research team for the EMEA region. The role combines team leadership, development of the research roadmap, commercial ownership of the Lens EMEA Power and Renewables offering, senior level industry engagement and collaboration with internal stakeholders (product, sales, marketing, consulting) to drive impact and commercial success.

The candidate will define and deliver the research roadmap for the EMEA Power and Renewables offering, lead the team responsible for shaping Wood Mackenzie's EMEA power and renewables market intelligence, and represent Wood Mackenzie across the region's energy industry through frequent engagement with clients, media and industry stakeholders. They will work closely with colleagues across research, product, sales, marketing and consulting to ensure our market views and product offering remain relevant, differentiated, timely, actionable and commercially successful.

As Wood Mackenzie continues to evolve from a leading research provider into a connected intelligence platform, spanning data, analytics, technology and expert insight, this role will strengthen and extend our leadership in EMEA power and renewables markets.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own the research content strategy for EMEA power and renewables and decide how the offering develops in response to market changes and client demand, while providing predictive and actionable intelligence. Ensure that the EMEA Power and Renewables views feed into Wood Mackenzie’s broader integrated and connected offerings across its portfolio.

* Lead, coach and develop a team of research analysts and senior analysts covering wind, solar, energy storage and power markets across EMEA, building analytical depth, subject matter expertise, and succession plans within the team.

* Hold commercial management responsibility for the EMEA Power and Renewables Lens offering, tracking performance and working with product, sales and marketing to ensure the offering meets its commercial targets.

* Define and deliver the roadmap for EMEA Power and Renewables, working with the product team to prioritise new content, data, and functionality that meet evolving client needs.

* Partner closely with sales, marketing and consulting teams to support renewals, upsell and bespoke client engagements, and to effectively market the team's research and the wider Lens offering.

* Produce and oversee high-quality, forward-looking thought leadership, including written research, commentary, and presentations, that anticipate and respond to major developments across wind, solar, storage and power markets.

* Represent Wood Mackenzie through frequent engagement with the industry — media, conferences and client events — building a distinctive and authoritative public profile that reinforces our position as the most trusted and integrated source of EMEA power and renewables intelligence.

* Build and sustain relationships with senior clients and prospects, including industry C-suite, investment leadership, and government and institutional stakeholders, driving commercial outcomes and deepening Wood Mackenzie's market influence across the region.

* Own headcount planning, hiring and resource allocation for the team, ensuring the right mix of skills and coverage across the region's markets.

**Experience**

You will bring 10+ years of experience in power and renewables market research, analysis or consulting, potentially gained within a major energy company, utility, developer, or a leading research and analytics firm.

You will have:

* Expertise in EMEA power market fundamentals, complemented by strong working knowledge of wind, solar and energy storage markets.

* Demonstrated experience leading and developing a team of analysts or researchers, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

* Commercial experience managing a subscription, portfolio, research or data product, including ownership of a product roadmap and working cross-functionally with sales, product and marketing to drive commercial performance.

* Strong written skills and a proven track record of delivering market analysis to inform high-stakes strategic, investment, or policy decisions.

* Experience representing an organization's views externally — through media commentary, conference speaking, published research, and client presentations. Recognised as a subject matter expert or thought leader.
* Established relationships with senior figures across the EMEA energy sector, including executives, investors, and government or institutional stakeholders.

* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distil complex market dynamics into compelling narratives for senior audiences.

* Familiarity with data-driven and quantitative approaches to market analysis, and an appetite to work at the frontier of how power and renewables market intelligence is developed.

* Strong problem-solving skills and AI-forward thinking

title: Head of Secondary
description:
**About the School - The British School of Barcelona (Castelldefels):**  
The British School of Barcelona (BSB) is a great school in a wonderful location. We are an HMC school and were judged by a recent BSO (British Schools Overseas) inspection to be outstanding in every area, including quality of education, safeguarding, pupil welfare and academic outcomes.
  
  
BSB is a large, very popular school for children aged 3 to 18. Our curriculum is based on the English National Curriculum, and we offer a wide range of GCSEs, A levels, BTEC and the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB), all alongside a significant enrichment programme.
  
  
Approximately 2350 students from more than 74 nationalities attend the school and over 375 staff work at BSB. We are based in three locations, two just outside the city of Barcelona – in Castelldefels, where we have a Primary, Secondary and Pre-University campus, and in the cosmopolitan town of Sitges, where we have another Primary campus. There are two more campuses in Barcelona, located in the heart of the city and featuring a Foundation campus, BSB Esperanza, which offers EY and Year 1 (opened in September 2021), as well as a brand-new main campus, BSB Luca, which offers Primary, Secondary, and Pre-University education and opened in September 2023.
  
  
In September 2026 we opened another campus, initially for EYFS and Primary-aged students, north of Barcelona, in the Maresme area.
  
  
The growth of the school has been accompanied by significant investment over recent years, including the building of a state-of–the art Pre-University Centre (Nexus), a full-sized 4G rugby and football pitch, dedicated STEAM facilities and the new BSB City and Maresme campuses.
  
  
Barcelona is a wonderful place to live, combining an amazing city with beaches and mountains nearby. The quality of life is excellent with a mild climate and year-round sunshine.
  
  
The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced **Head of Secondary** to join our fantastic team.
  
  
**About Cognita:**  
Cognita is a global leader in independent education. Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 90 schools in 20 countries - in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East - serving more than 100,000 students. Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".
  
  
At Cognita, we know every student is unique. We nurture their distinct personalities and strengths. We support them academically, socially, and emotionally, wherever they are in the world, wherever they’re starting from. And each and every one of our schools is unique too.
  
  
We protect what’s special about them, while offering them rich knowledge, opportunities, and best practices. And they get to be part of something bigger. We open their classrooms to the collective wisdom of over 90 schools in 20 countries, ensuring every child gets an education that’s, quite literally, world class.
  
  
It’s an individual approach that empowers every school, teacher and student to focus on what they do best and thrive.
  
  
**About the Role:**  
We are seeking an exceptional and inspirational leader to join our Senior Leadership Team as Head of Secondary, Castelldefels. This pivotal role is responsible for leading our Secondary School across both the Main Site and Nexus Sixth Form, ensuring outstanding academic achievement, student wellbeing, and personal development for all learners from Years 7 to 13. Working closely with the Executive Principal and senior colleagues, you will drive strategic school improvement, lead and develop high-performing teams, oversee the quality of teaching and learning, and ensure excellence in day-to-day operations. The successful candidate will champion a positive and inclusive school culture, strengthen student recruitment and retention, and play a key role in delivering a holistic educational experience that prepares students for success both in school and beyond.  
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For:**  
We are looking for an outstanding educational leader with significant senior leadership experience and a proven track record of driving academic excellence and sustained school improvement. The successful candidate will be a qualified teacher with a degree and recognised teaching qualification, combining strategic vision with a genuine commitment to student wellbeing, safeguarding, and holistic education. An inspiring and collaborative leader, you will be skilled at coaching, motivating, and developing others, while building strong relationships across the school community. You will possess excellent communication skills, up-to-date educational knowledge, and the creativity to navigate challenges with confidence and positivity. Above all, you will demonstrate integrity, resilience, a strong work ethic, and a passion for creating an environment where both students and staff can thrive.
  
  
**Benefits at Cognita:**  
What we can offer you:
  

* A fantastic team of staff who are committed, supportive and collaborative.
* The wider support of BSB, including access to high level CPD and future career opportunities.
* The support of the Cognita network, including cross-school learning partnerships.

  
All positions are offered with attractive packages including competitive salaries, places for staff children in BSB, and other local benefits.
  
  
**How to Apply:**  
Complete this application before the closing date.
  
**The Closing Date for Applications is:** Friday 23rd October 2026
  
**First stage interviews:** Monday 5th November 2026 - Tuesday 13th November 2026
  
**Final stage interviews:** Friday 23rd November 2026
  
  
Cognita Schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.
  
  
We are an equal opportunities employer committed to diversity and treating all employees with dignity and respect regardless of background.
  
  
Early applications are encouraged, we reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to closing date for the right applicant.

title: AI Development Director
description:
### **About The Role**

This job profile outlines a role that balances solid professional experience, a strategic mindset, and hands-on technical delivery. The successful candidate will combine sound business judgment with the ability to personally evaluate existing AI tools and solutions, frame the right use cases for the business, and quickly implement working developments for the Business Units and Corporate functions. This is a type of hybrid strategy-plus-build profile.

As the AI Development Director, this position plays a pivotal role in **shaping the artificial intelligence agenda** of the company while **personally delivering the solutions** that bring it to life. The role combines **strategic framing of AI opportunities**, evaluation of existing tools and vendor solutions, and **rapid hands-on implementation** of developments requested by the Business Units and Corporate functions. Reporting directly to the Chief Innovation and Strategy Officer, and with the perspective of leading a small team of developers, this role significantly contributes to the organization's innovation roadmap, operational efficiency, and competitive positioning. The primary objectives of this role include:

* **Support the definition of the AI Roadmap**: Lead the development and continuous refinement of the Group’s AI strategy and roadmap, **aligning AI investments with corporate and business priorities**, and presenting progress to the Board of Directors and ExCom
* **Evaluate tools and deliver solutions hands-on**: Assess the AI tools and platforms available in the market and already in use at the Group, select the right approach for each business need, and **personally implement working solutions** — quickly and pragmatically — for the Business Units and Corporate functions, from agriculture and operations to commercial, finance, and HR
* **Develop AI and Technology perspective**: **Track the evolving AI landscape**, critically evaluate emerging models, tools and vendors, benchmark competitor and industry adoption, and translate trends into actionable, prioritized opportunities for the Group
* **Drive AI delivery and governance**: **Own the end-to-end AI delivery cycle** — from use-case identification and feasibility, through data readiness, model development, deployment and scaling — while establishing **responsible-AI, data-privacy, and risk-management standards** across the Group
* **Collaborate with Group’s top Executives and lead a small delivery team**: Partner with the CISO and ExCom stakeholders to **embed AI into business priorities**, working with IT, operations, commercial, marketing, finance, human resources, and Business Units teams to co-design solutions, secure data access, and drive change management for AI adoption. Where needed, lead and mentor a small team of analysts to extend delivery capacity while **remaining personally hands-on with the technical work**

### **About You**

* Ideal candidate has **6-10 years of professional experience** and is currently a Manager or Senior Manager within the **advanced analytics / AI practice of a top-tier strategy consulting firm** — BCG X, McKinsey QuantumBlack, Bain Advanced Analytics, Kearney Digital, or equivalent — with strong analytical capabilities and **proven hands-on AI experience**; candidates from the general strategy practice are not the target profile; complementary time in industry, a technology company, or a hyperscaler / AI-native organization is a plus, as is some experience leading a small team of analysts
* Demonstrated leadership skills: successfully **collaborate with CEO and ExCo members** to set the AI vision, execute assignments and deliver tangible business outcomes
* Strategic thinking paired with strong execution instincts: ability to **frame the problem, choose the right tool, and move from idea to deployed solution** in short cycles, with sound Project / Product management, Change leadership, and Cross-functional collaboration skills
* AI expertise across the full delivery lifecycle — **generative AI / LLMs, classical machine learning, MLOps**, and data engineering foundations — with the ability to evaluate existing tools and vendor solutions, decide **build-vs-buy pragmatically**, and personally take solutions from **prototype to production**
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to adapt to diverse and evolving business needs
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with hands-on technical fluency (**Python, SQL, cloud AI platforms** such as Azure / AWS / GCP) and the ability to develop impactful presentation decks (PowerPoint) for executive audiences
* Proven ability to **work autonomously end-to-end** — from problem framing to deployed solution — with limited supervision and under pressure
* Attention to detail coupled with strategic thinking. **High curiosity and a hunger to learn**

**Location & Travel**

This is a 100% on-site position based at our Madrid offices. The role requires broad flexibility and willingness to travel frequently and internationally, wherever the business needs it.

### **About Us**

**AMFRESH Group** is a global agrifood innovation company shaping the future of FRESH food through innovation, science and technology. Through its vertically integrated business model, the Group combines proprietary genetics and breeding, agriscience, biotechnology, sustainable farming and global commercialization to translate scientific innovation into commercial impact at scale. With more than 95 years of expertise, AMFRESH is privately held, operates in over 60 countries and employs more than 12,000 people worldwide. AMFRESH partners with many of the world's leading retailers and growers to deliver differentiated products, trusted supply and innovation across the FRESH food value chain, helping build healthier, more resilient and more sustainable food systems.

  

For further information, visit www.amfresh.com.

description:
