title: Associate Director, School of Science & Technology - Operations
description:
Overview:

Are you interested in joining a dynamic and international team of professionals to transform education? IE University's **School of Science & Technology** is looking for an **Associate Director - Operations** to join its team!

IE University (IEU) is a private university with campuses located in Segovia and Madrid (Spain). IEU programs are taught in English and Spanish and fully comply with the terms of the Bologna Accords for the European Higher Education Area.

The Associate Director (AD) will be a key point of contact for faculty, students and the program team. The position combines the standard responsibilities of an Associate Director for undergraduate program operations with a stronger focus on faculty operations, faculty data management, teaching quality assurance and the continuous improvement of academic delivery. The primary responsibility is to guarantee the efficient flow of day-to-day operations while ensuring that faculty-facing processes, academic information and quality controls are reliable, timely and consistently applied.

The Associate Director will report to the Senior Associate Director and will supervise and coordinate the work of Program Coordinators and Program Assistants. In addition, the Associate Director will work closely with the Assistant Vice Dean on projects and initiatives related to faculty, while maintaining the direct reporting and accountability line to the Senior Associate Director. The position will interact regularly with faculty, students, academic leadership, other IE departments and external agencies whose involvement is required to run the programs and support academic quality.

The position will be based in our Madrid Campus, though it will eventually be required to travel to the Segovia Campus, on a same-day-return to Madrid basis, in case any coordination meetings with internal or external stakeholders may take place there.

**Why IE University?**

Every story begins with a purpose, and ours has always been about people. Founded in 1973, IE University has continuously raised the bar to drive positive change through education. We believe education is more than a path to professional success; it is a catalyst for personal transformation and meaningful impact.

At IE University, we place people and their potential at the center of everything we do, empowering individuals to become extraordinary. We encourage bold thinking and foster a culture where innovation, curiosity, and courage lead to real-world impact. Together, we create an environment where talent thrives, and ideas shape the future.

**Our mission**

We support students in developing impact skills to live and lead with positive impact. This ignites a ripple effect: We transform people, who then transform others, systems, society, and, ultimately, our world.

**Our Purpose**

To foster positive change.

**Values**

* Cultivate the humanistic approach.
* Empower your entrepreneurial spirit
* Cherish the diversity of people, mind, and experience
* Drive innovation with a proactive mindset

We are looking for a person to join a full-time position in **Madrid - IE Tower.**

Responsibilities:

**Your role as an Associate Director will involve:**

*Faculty operations, faculty interaction and data integrity*

* Maintain, update and optimize a comprehensive faculty database, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, confidentiality and traceability of information on academic credentials, accreditation status where applicable, contractual details, course assignments, teaching loads, availability and relevant historical records.
* Act as a regular and reliable point of coordination for faculty, providing clear guidance, facilitating requests, gathering feedback and ensuring appropriate follow-up across the School and relevant IE departments.
* Oversee faculty-facing workflows, including onboarding, course allocation, academic calendars, teaching documentation, grade submission and the resolution of operational matters escalated by the program team.
* Identify data gaps, inconsistencies or risks and coordinate their timely resolution. Provide academic leadership with decision-ready faculty information to support planning, recruitment, teaching allocation, continuity and retention discussions.

*Teaching quality assurance and academic compliance*

* Design and execute evidence-based reviews of teaching delivery using end-of-term student feedback, mid-semester evaluations, course documentation and other approved indicators of classroom and program outcomes.
* Monitor adherence to core academic responsibilities, including timely submission of grades, complete and up-to-date syllabi, appropriate organization of course materials in the Learning Management System (LMS) and compliance with academic policies and deadlines.
* Analyze student feedback and teaching delivery trends to identify strengths, recurring issues, data gaps and areas requiring support or improvement, distinguishing isolated events from sustained patterns.
* Collaborate with the Senior Associate Director, the Assistant Vice Dean, Program Directors and other academic leaders to define proportionate follow-up actions, faculty support measures, professional development recommendations and improvement plans.
* Ensure that quality assurance processes and conclusions are evidence-based, documented, consistently applied and handled with due confidentiality and professional judgement.

*Reporting, insight and continuous improvement*

* Prepare clear and actionable reports on faculty data quality, teaching delivery, academic compliance, student feedback trends, operational risks and progress against agreed actions for academic and School leadership, as appropriate.
* Use analytical and data visualization tools to convert complex information into decision-ready insights, clearly documenting definitions, data sources, assumptions and limitations.
* Identify opportunities to streamline faculty-related processes, improve data collection, strengthen controls and reduce operational friction. Update academic guides, templates and tools used with faculty and students.
* Support internal and external quality assurance, accreditation, audit and reporting exercises by providing accurate, complete and traceable evidence within required deadlines.

*Undergraduate program operations and student experience*

* Guarantee the efficient flow of daily operations across the bachelor’s degrees and proactively improve operational processes and student satisfaction.
* Meet with students to solve issues, offer advice and provide appropriate support when relevant matters are escalated or require Associate Director involvement.
* Co-manage interactions with class representatives together with the Program Managers, support effective student communications and assist students facing academic or other program-related challenges.
* Identify and implement ways to improve the student experience, ensuring coherence between faculty-facing and student-facing processes.

*School projects and cross-functional coordination*

* Assist the Academic Director, Executive Director, Senior Associate Director, Assistant Vice Dean and relevant Program Directors in curricular and extracurricular activities, innovation initiatives and faculty-related projects.
* Take responsibility for specific program or School projects, including components of program design, curriculum review, revamp projects, academic process redesign or faculty operations initiatives.
* Collaborate with other IE departments and coordinate with external agencies or partners when their participation is required for program operations, quality assurance or academic compliance.

*Team coordination and capability building*

* Supervise and coordinate the work of Program Coordinators and Program Assistants with professionalism, clear priorities, appropriate workload allocation and accountability for agreed service standards.
* Coach and train team members in faculty operations, data management, quality assurance routines, new processes and the consistent application of School and IE policies.
* Promote effective documentation, knowledge sharing and business continuity, enabling routine matters to be resolved independently and material risks to be escalated promptly.

Qualifications:

**To thrive in this role, you should possess the following qualifications:**

* A Master’s degree, preferably from a top university, in Higher Education Administration, Data Analytics, Operations Management, Education, Business or a related discipline.
* A minimum of five years’ professional experience in academic administration, quality assurance, faculty affairs, program operations or a comparable field, preferably in a fast-paced or international university environment.
* Advanced written and oral proficiency in English is required. Professional fluency in Spanish is highly advantageous.
* Advanced database management skills and experience with CRM platforms and Learning Management Systems such as Blackboard or Canvas. Familiarity with Power BI or Tableau is highly desirable.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a proven ability to maintain complex datasets with a consistently high level of accuracy.
* Strong analytical judgement, project management capabilities, stakeholder management skills, ability to work under pressure and a high level of accountability.
* High emotional intelligence, discretion and tact, with the confidence to discuss evidence, expectations and constructive feedback with senior academic professionals.
* Experience in global management education or within a technology-focused higher education school will be considered a plus.
* A positive and proactive attitude, combining a faculty partnership mindset with a strong commitment to student experience, academic standards and confidentiality.
* Candidates must be in possession of a valid EU work permit.

Unleash your full potential and make an impact. The next move is yours!

If you want to be part of this educational revolution, we invite you to apply and be part of our dynamic team at **IE University.**

*At IE University, we actively promote equal opportunities in recruitment processes and access to employment, always ensuring the absence of gender, sexual orientation, religion, age, ethnic origin, or disability bias throughout the entire selection process.*

title: GLOBAL CORPORATE COMMUNICATIONS MANAGER

Provide insight and challenge to leaders on organizational health, leadership effectiveness, capability needs, and workforce risks.

Anticipate organizational capability needs and develop strategies to build future-ready teams.

Enable leaders to successfully navigate ambiguity, organizational change, and transformation.  
Foster a positive employee experience that supports retention and performance.

Provide guidance on complex employee relations matters and organizational risk.  
Partner with Legal, Compliance, Labor Relations, and HR colleagues to ensure effective and compliant people practices.

* Experience supporting global functional organizations in complex, matrixed environments.

* Strong business and financial acumen with an ability to connect people strategy to business outcomes.
* Experience operating within highly regulated industries, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, healthcare, life sciences, manufacturing, or related sectors.
* Proven ability to influence executive leaders and navigate complex stakeholder environments.
* Strong analytical capability with experience leveraging workforce data to drive decisions

* Enterprise mindset with the ability to connect business strategy and people strategy.
* Executive presence and credibility with senior leaders.
* Courage to challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
* Exceptional judgment and decision-making capability.
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and lead through transformation.
* Strong collaborative and stakeholder management skills.
* Data-driven and insight-oriented approach to problem solving.
* Bias for action, ownership, and execution.
* Global perspective with appreciation for diverse cultures and operating environments.

**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------

At Teva, better health starts from within, and that includes you. From day one, you’ll be supported with benefits designed to help you thrive in and out of work. This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community. Here, you’ll be part of a culture that empowers you to reach your goals and prioritize your wellbeing every step of the way.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
**About us**

Do you live to create? Looking for your next big challenge? How about a breath of fresh air? As part of the Omnicom Agencies Group, the 14 Agency network handles all global advertising for CUPRA and SEAT car brands. With offices in 11 countries and counting, 14 is a place for those who like to bend the rules. It's a place for rock'n'roll. At the heart of Barcelona, and beyond.

It is also a place where a diverse mix of talented people want to come, to stay and do their best work. Our dedication to promoting diversity, multiculturalism, and inclusion is clearly reflected in our teams and across all of our work. Diversity is more than a commitment for us — it is the foundation of what we do.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for a Social Media Strategist to join the CUPRA Global Social Strategy team. Someone with an insatiable curiosity about digital culture, platforms, and communities, and the ability to translate all of that into strategy.

Someone who experiences the internet beyond their feed; who understands the lore, knows what's behind the screenmaxing, and recognizes when something is "that's so AI." Someone who scrolls with curiosity, knows how to separate the noise from the signals that matter, and connects what's happening online with what's happening in the real world.

Your challenge will be to transform this constant reading of culture into strategic opportunities for CUPRA. Because knowing what's happening online is good; understanding what it means for the brand and what to do with it is what makes the difference.

**Responsibilities**

***1. Social Media Strategy***

Develop social strategies aligned with CUPRA's positioning and objectives.

Define opportunities, territories, and strategic approaches to build a relevant and distinctive social presence.

Translate brand and business challenges into actionable strategies, briefs, and recommendations.

Contribute to evolving the role of social media within CUPRA's global strategy.

***2. Cultural & Audience Intelligence***

Identify cultural shifts, behaviors, communities, and conversations relevant to the brand.

Analyze platforms and audiences to understand what motivates them, how they engage, and what they expect from brands.

Transform cultural and social insights into strategic perspectives and opportunities for CUPRA.

Distinguish between a trend that deserves attention and an opportunity that warrants a brand response.

***3. Strategic Development & Measurement***

Develop strategic frameworks and criteria to guide social media decisions.

Work with Social Creative, Content Planning, and Data to connect strategy, ideas, and results.

Evaluate the contribution of social media initiatives to brand objectives, incorporating lessons learned into future strategies.

Present and defend strategic recommendations to teams and stakeholders.

***Profile we are looking for:***

Experience in Social Media Strategy, Digital Strategy, or brand and communications strategy.

Solid knowledge of the main social media platforms and their codes.

Curiosity about contemporary culture, communities, entertainment, and audience behavior.

Ability to transform information into insights and insights into a clear strategic direction.

Critical thinking, independent judgment, and the ability to construct and defend a point of view.

Ability to connect brand, business, culture, and social media without resorting to generic approaches.

Good communication and presentation skills, autonomy, and the ability to work in a team.

Advanced English; experience with global brands is a plus.

Demonstrable experience understanding social media and internet culture.

**In short**: someone who not only understands what's happening on social media, but also what it means for CUPRA and what the brand should do about it.

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sexual orientation, or age.

Your personal information will be used according to our Recruitment Privacy Notice. View our Recruitment Privacy Notice here when you apply.

description:
Job Requisition ID: 20804

Date Posted: 16 October 2026

Closing Date: 6 November 2026 23:59 CET/CEST

Publication Method: Internal & External

Type of Appointment (learn more): Fixed-Term

Directorate: Human and Robotic Exploration

Workplace:
Villanueva de la Cañada, ES

Grade Band (learn more): A2 - A4

This is a **fixed-term appointment** with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years.

  

**Location**
  
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands with a resident assignment to ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain.

**Description**
---------------

The Directorate of Human and Robotic Exploration Programmes (D/HRE) is a programme directorate within the ESA matrix structure. Through a partnership between humans and robots, D/HRE is dedicated to exploring destinations in space where humans are already living and working —– or will live and work in the future —– for the purpose of scientific research, economic development, international cooperation and public inspiration.

The Science Operations Department (SCI-S), within ESA’s Directorate of Science (D/SCI), hosts the scientists and engineers who oversee the space missions from study to the end of operations, develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, and archives and curates their data during operations and beyond. The Department provides support to D/HRE in the curation, archiving and dissemination of data from its planetary missions, such as the Rosalind Franklin Mission (RFM) and other Mars or lunar experiments. Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind.

You will be assigned as Archive Scientist for ESA planetary missions under the direct responsibility of the Chief Exploration Scientist reporting functionally to the Head of the Science Archives Development and Operations Section, also known as the ESAC Science Data Centre (ESDC) in the Data Science and Archives Division within the Science Operations Department (SCI-S).

You will have further functional reporting lines within the mission(s) you support, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor.

**Duties**
----------

You will be responsible for the definition and specification of the scientific archive for the supported ESA planetary missions, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor, and for the follow-up and monitoring of its implementation and operation with the goal of maximising the scientific return of the missions. You will work in close collaboration with the planetary mission project scientists, the other mission archive scientists, the ESDC Software and Data Systems Architect and the members of the Planetary Science Archive User Group.

  

As Archive Scientist, your specific responsibilities will include:

  

* ownership of use cases and drivers for the mission archives, including:
  + interfacing with the Project Scientist, the Science Operations Centre (SOC) team, other archive science leads and other archive scientists, as well as the external stakeholders, such as the instrument teams and the mission scientific community, to provide the science use cases that drive the mission archive and determine the priorities for implementation;
  + providing scientific support and steering the development and operations of the archives for the supported ESA planetary missions, providing the ESDC development team with an archive user requirements document as a baseline for implementation;
* chairing and coordinating a mission-level Data Archive Working Group (DAWG);
* monitoring the implementation, testing and expected performance of the archive based on use cases gathered by the mission team and derived requirements; in particular, defining and performing the end user acceptance testing of the different archive versions prior to their release to the scientific community;
* with the help of the instrument operations scientists, supervising and coordinating the definition and provision of science data products and any higher-level data products from the community or instrument teams as needed, including liaising on submission schedules and content;
* liaising with any internal and external providers to ensure the completeness of all levels of data products with maximum science quality, contributing to the optimisation and refinement of the archive products when possible;
* encouraging and contributing to the science exploitation of the missions’ data products through archive usage;
* participating in archive scientist meetings and user groups and sharing ideas and proposals for the strategy and promotion of the ESA science archives;
* supporting the scientific community with archive- and data product-related matters.
  

As a scientist in the Department, you will be required to actively pursue personal scientific research, publishing articles using archival data, and to actively participate in the Department’s research activities.

**Technical competencies**
--------------------------

Experience in science data management and archiving systems

Experience working with planetary science data in a research setting, preferably including data from surface/in situ planetary missions

Experience in coordinating the scientific community and managing multiple interfaces at international level within a large multidisciplinary team.

Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions

**Behavioural competencies**
----------------------------

Result Orientation
  
Operational Efficiency
  
Fostering Cooperation
  
Relationship Management
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Forward Thinking

**Education and professional experience**
-----------------------------------------

A PhD in a relevant domain is required for this post, together with one year of relevant professional experience.

**Additional requirements**
---------------------------

The following are assets for this position:

  

* Experience in promoting science to the wider scientific community and general public;
* Understanding of user needs in relation to complex software systems;
* Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions;
* Experience in agile and DevOps methodologies, human factor engineering (UX design) and associated technologies and their use in modern software engineering.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness**
  
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.

  

**Important Information and Disclaimer**
  
In principle, recruitment will be within the advertised grade band (A2-A4). However, if the selected candidate has less than four years of relevant professional experience following the completion of the master’s degree, the position may be filled at A1 level.

Applicants must be eligible to access information, technology, and hardware which is subject to European or US export control and sanctions regulations.

During the recruitment process, the Agency may request applicants to undergo selection tests. Additionally, successful candidates will need to undergo basic screening before appointment, which will be conducted by an external background screening service, in compliance with the European Space Agency's security procedures.

Note that ESA is in the process of transitioning to a Matrix setup, which could lead to organisational changes affecting this position.

The information published on ESA’s careers website regarding working conditions is correct at the time of publication. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may not address all questions you would have.

  

**Nationality and Languages**
  
Please note that applications are only considered from nationals of one of the following States: Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and Canada, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania and Slovakia.

According to the ESA Convention, staff shall be recruited on the basis of their qualifications, taking into account an adequate distribution of posts among nationals of the Member States.

The working languages of the Agency are English and French. A good knowledge of one of these is required. Knowledge of another Member State language would be an asset.

title: General Manager - Marketing and Ecommerce Growth
location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
**HoopStars | Parent-company Marketing Team Lead**
Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.
  
  
**Build the business. Build the marketing team.**
HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.
  
  
You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.
  
  
You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand
* Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention
* Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands
* Establish commercial discipline: Connect campaign performance to paying customers, repeat enrollment and contribution profit. Allocate marketing investment using reliable reporting and testing
* Stay close to execution: Inspect advertising accounts, diagnose funnel problems and help launch improvements yourself while building a team that can execute consistently

**Support and autonomy**
The parent provides bookkeeping assistance, HR support, IT and website support, and a local manager covering customer service and day-to-day sales. You will propose budgets and team plans, then make operating decisions within agreed authority. After onboarding, the founder expects a monthly business review, supported by clear weekly reporting and escalation of exceptional issues.
  
  
**Your first 90 days**
Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Who we are looking for**
You may have built an ecommerce business, led growth for a consumer brand, run a digital agency with meaningful operating responsibility, or managed a business where digital acquisition was central to its success.
  
  

* Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention
* Commercial responsibility beyond a marketing budget: pricing, margins, staffing, forecasts or business profitability
* Experience hiring and managing marketers, creatives, agencies or other specialists
* Ability to translate ecommerce methods into a service business with real delivery capacity and customer commitments
* Comfort doing practical work while developing people and systems
* Strong professional English and effective remote leadership

Experience in youth sports, education, fitness, memberships or multi-location services is useful. Evidence of building a profitable business and an effective team matters most.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Submit your CV through this application form. Describe a business or brand you grew, including spend, results and your personal contribution; a team you built or managed; and a commercial decision that failed and what you changed afterward.
  
  
Complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners using that email, indicate this in the form.
  
  

* Culture Index survey
* Criteria GAME assessment - English

**Benefits**
Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.
  
  
Remote work from LATAM, with Toronto-hours collaboration. Opportunity to build and lead a business and the parent marketing team, with equity opportunity subject to agreed terms. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

title: Director, Brand Design
description:
**About Us**

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick-care" to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again".

Reporting to the VP, Design & Experience, the Director, Creative will lead Prenuvo's Creative function and oversee a multidisciplinary team of contributors. This leadership role is responsible for the Creative function as a whole; its people, capabilities, priorities, creative vision, quality, and effectiveness. The Director, Creative will oversee Prenuvo's creative expression across brand, campaigns, paid media, social, web, content, motion, physical environments, events, partnerships, and emerging experiences.

Your role is both directive and integrative. You'll set the creative vision and quality bar while leading through your team, giving them the clarity, ownership, and autonomy to independently direct programs, disciplines, and bodies of work. You'll partner closely with Marketing, Growth, Product Design, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other subject-matter experts to ensure creative work is compelling, accurate, and responsive to the needs of a healthcare environment.

You'll combine a strong creative point of view with organizational leadership—building the team and capabilities we need, establishing scalable creative practices, and partnering across the company to turn brand and business strategy into exceptional creative work. This is a fully remote position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States. Occasional travel may be required for team gatherings, productions, events, and other business needs.

**This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).**

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people's lives!

**What You'll Do**

* **Vision & creative direction**
  + Own and evolve Prenuvo's creative expression, translating brand and business strategy into a distinctive experience across channels.
  + Set the creative vision, principles, and quality standards that guide the brand design team and its partners.
  + Provide senior creative direction for major campaigns, launches, partnerships, and brand initiatives while empowering Creative Leads to direct individual programs and bodies of work.
  + Ensure the brand remains cohesive while continuing to evolve as Prenuvo, its audiences, and its offerings grow.
* **Organizational leadership**
  + Own the structure, capabilities, performance, and development of Prenuvo's Creative function, building a multidisciplinary team capable of supporting the company's evolving brand and business needs.
  + Lead and develop team members, establishing clear accountability and empowering them to lead their teams and work independently.
  + Identify capability and talent gaps and determine where to build internally versus leverage agencies, freelancers, and production partners.
  + Create an environment of high standards, collaboration, accountability, creative ambition, and professional growth.
* **Portfolio, priorities, and resources**
  + Own creative portfolio planning and resourcing, partnering with the VP of Design & Experience and cross-functional leaders to prioritize creative investment against the company's highest-value opportunities.
  + Balance business demand, team capacity, strategic importance, and creative opportunity when establishing priorities.
  + Ensure the Creative organization has the right talent, partners, processes, and resources to deliver against company priorities.
  + Provide visibility into creative priorities, capacity, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership.
* **Cross-functional leadership**
  + Serving as the senior creative authority to the local brand design and creative team while taking broader direction from the VP, Design and Experience and partnering with leaders across Marketing, Growth, Product, Clinical, Commercial, CX, and other functions.
  + Translate business objectives, audience insights, and channel strategies into creative opportunities and direction.
  + Present and advocate for creative strategy and work with senior and executive stakeholders.
  + Partner closely with Product Design where brand and product experiences intersect, creating continuity while maintaining clear ownership between the two functions.
* **Creative systems and effectiveness**
* + Establish scalable approaches to creative intake, prioritization, briefing, review, production, and delivery.
  + Oversee agencies, freelancers, production partners, and other external creative resources.
  + Partner with Marketing and Growth to understand creative performance and translate learnings into stronger creative strategy.
  + Balance brand-building and performance objectives, ensuring short-term optimization doesn't come at the expense of long-term brand equity.
  + Identify opportunities for AI and emerging technologies to improve creative exploration, production, scalability, and efficiency.
  + Remain connected to the work and step directly into creative development when the scale, complexity, or strategic importance of an initiative warrants it.

**What You'll Bring**

* 15+ years of experience in creative, brand, design, or related disciplines, including significant creative leadership experience.
* 5+ years managing and developing creative teams and senior creative talent, with demonstrated success building high-performing multidisciplinary organizations.
* An exceptional portfolio demonstrating brand thinking and creative direction across multiple channels and experiences.
* Deep experience across brand, digital, web, paid advertising, social, video/motion, and integrated campaigns.
* Experience with physical or experiential design—including retail, clinics, hospitality, or events—is highly valued.
* Strong understanding of both brand building and performance marketing.
* Demonstrated experience with portfolio prioritization, resource planning, team building, and organizational development.
* Experience managing agencies, production partners, freelancers, budgets, and complex creative programs.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and articulate the thinking behind creative decisions.
* Familiarity with product and UX design and the ability to partner effectively with Product Design leadership.
* Strong understanding of contemporary creative tools and emerging AI-enabled creative technologies.
* Consumer marketing experience in healthcare, HealthTech, MedTech, wellness, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.

**Our Values**

First: we are **Pioneers**

* Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are **Platform-Builders**

* We're always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what's ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are **Patients**

* We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients' lives, and we won't stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

**What We Offer**

* An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
* We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
* Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we're doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
* Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
* Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
* Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
* We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
* **The base salary for this role ranges from $180,000-$210,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location**

*We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

*As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.*

**Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain [****prenuvo.com****]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.**

Si quieres ser parte de **agencia boutique** que trabaja con estructuras flexibles, equipos pequeños y en crecimiento bajo un modelo de trabajo basado en la **autenticidad y la creatividad estratégica.**

**Combinada con el uso de tecnología y storytelling** como herramientas para **crear experiencias** para las marcas y conectarlas con las personas.

**¡Esta es tu oportunidad!**

**Sobre la Oportunidad**

Hoy en día cuenta con un equipo diverso con colaboradores que aportan desde distintos países como: Argentina, Brasil, Perú **México.** El cual, **este último** se encuentra en etapa de crecimiento.

¡Actualmente estamos buscando fortalecer nuestro equipo de marketing! con el próximo/a/x: **Creative Copywriter.**

El/la/x **Creative Copywriter** será responsable de convertir briefs estratégico agrandes conceptos creativos, para distintas campañas integrada a headlines.

Valorarán que la persona cuente con una mente rápida, curiosa, obsesión por las ideas y sabiendo que una buena idea en redes puede caber en un hook de tres segundos.

**¿Cómo vas a lograrlo?** Entre tus responsabilidades, estarán:

* Crear **conceptos, headlines, manifiestos, taglines, scripts, copies y storytelling** para diferentes plataformas y formatos.
* **Escribir para campañas integradas:** digital, social, experiencias, branded content, activaciones, Reels, TikToks y videos para creators y otros canales.
* Trabajar de manera colaborativa con diseñadores, directores de arte, estrategas y otros perfiles creativos.
* Participar en sesiones de brainstorming y contribuir activamente a elevar el trabajo creativo del equipo.

* Adaptar una misma idea a diferentes audiencias, formatos y mercados sin perder su esencia.
* Mantener un **estándar alto de craft**, desde una gran idea hasta el último detalle de una pieza.
* Explorar nuevas herramientas, tecnologías y formatos —incluyendo AI— como parte natural del proceso creativo.

* Experiencia **mínima de 3 años: como Copywriter o un rol similar.** *(Preferentemente que hayas trabajado en Agencia)*
* Experiencia en la creación de contenido dinámico, adaptado a tendencias y formatos.
* *Experiencia trabajado con influencers o creators en campañas de marcas reconocidas -* **Un plus.**
* **Portafolio** con ideas y guiones hechos para redes.
* Excelente sensibilidad para el lenguaje, el tono y la cultura.
* Criterio para explicar **por qué una idea importa**, no solo cómo se ve.
* Curiosidad genuina por marcas, cultura, entretenimiento, tecnología y lo que está pasando alrededor.

title: Head of Performance Creative
description:
**Role Objective**
**AtlasBrands is looking for a Head of Performance Creative (Meta) to serve as the "CEO" of our primary acquisition channel.**
Because Meta represents 100% of our customer growth, you will take complete, end-to-end ownership of the channel and leading with an obsessive, direct-response creative strategy while cross-functionally overseeing media buying execution.
  
  
You are a world-class performance creative lead who stays deeply in the trenches, studying market trends and competitor ads to craft high-converting hooks and concepts. Your core objective is to build and scale a pod-based creative department that powers rapid revenue expansion while maintaining strict unit economics, total account stability, and proactive resolution of ad rejections and account risk across high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will transition current lead oversight, build custom tracking dashboards, and recruit an A-player team that executes with speed and autonomy.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Channel Onboarding & Transition: Audit active ad accounts, creative pipelines, and team members to deliver a clear execution plan. Fully assume Meta decision-making (budgets, launches, creative) and seamlessly transition the incumbent lead into a dedicated Creative Strategist role.
* Brand Scaling Systems: Execute staged growth targets for existing brands at first-rebill break-even or better. Establish a standardized launch protocol for new brands to reach scale rapidly while maintaining a near-perfect success rate.
* Retention & Margin Optimization: Shift brands from first-rebill break-even to first-purchase break-even as they mature, sustaining performance month-over-month. Proactively flag risks ahead of time with actionable recovery plans.
* Ad Rejection & Account Health Management: Rapidly troubleshoot and resolve ad rejections, policy flags, and disablements inherent to high-risk verticals (e.g., supplements). Set up and manage redundant account architecture (backup BMs, ad accounts, payment methods) to guarantee zero downtime and keep spend scaling uninterrupted.
* Pod Architecture & Department Building: Grade current team members and design final pod structures. Fully staff every pod with top-tier talent so strategists own creative direction end-to-end.
* Analytics & AI Operations: Build custom AI-driven live dashboards (using Claude) tracking spend, acquisition costs, payback periods, creative win rates, and rejection rates. Lead concise weekly executive syncs that require zero prep from leadership.

**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Proven $100K+/Day Scale: Track record taking DTC brands to aggressive scale, directly responsible for managing $100K+ daily Meta ad spend across catalog depth (6–10+ distinct SKUs).
* Direct-Response Mastery & In-the-Trenches Mindset: Obsessed with studying winning market trends, analyzing competitor ads, and turning consumer psychology into high-velocity creative concepts.
* Operational Resilience in High-Risk Verticals: Hands-on experience resolving policy flags, ad rejections, and account risks in supplement/health categories while keeping spend live via backup account infrastructure.
* High-Tempo Work Ethic (60+ Hrs/Wk): Hyper-ambitious operator who thrives under high pressure, brings a history of 60+ hour work weeks, and wants to grind alongside an elite team pushing toward 9 figures.
* Full Channel Ownership & Execution: Operates as a true "CEO of Meta"—building A-player creative pods, overseeing media buying alignment, and executing with extreme speed and autonomy.
* AI-Driven Automation: Leverages modern LLMs (Claude, GPTs) and automated data workflows to streamline creative analysis, build tracking dashboards, and scale output.

**Working Hours & Culture**

* Role Timeline: Full-time leadership hire.
* Async-First: Global, remote-first team setup requiring core daily overlap with US EST business hours for team syncs and cross-functional alignment.

**How To Apply & What To Expect**
At AtlasBrands, we value your time and expertise, which is why we’ve built a streamlined, highly transparent interview process designed to look for a true partner rather than a transactional contributor.

title: Head of Growth - DTC/eCommerce
location: Buenos Aires, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina
description:
Fabula is a fast-growing D2C coffee brand in the United States. We're looking for a Head of Growth aka killer performance media buyer/creative strategist who is already operating at a high level in eCommerce. This isn't a role for someone who wants to learn how to scale an eCommerce brand. We want someone who has already done it.
  
  
Our goal is simple: bring in someone who can jump in, take ownership of our growth engine, and take Fabula to the next level.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Paid media: Own and scale Meta as the primary acquisition channel, with additional experience across Google and/or TikTok Paid
* Creative strategy: Identify winning customer angles, hooks, messaging, formats, and concepts based on performance data and customer research
* Creative testing: Build and manage a systematic testing pipeline and rapidly identify winning creatives
* Full-funnel performance: Analyze and optimize the entire journey from ad advertorial/landing page offer conversion
* Research: Mine customer reviews, surveys, Reddit, competitor ads, Meta Ads Library, and other sources for new angles and opportunities
* Creative production: Brief and manage UGC creators, editors, and designers - while remaining hands-on with scripts, hooks, copy, and creative direction
* Performance analysis: Make daily decisions around what to scale, iterate, or kill based on CPA, ROAS, CTR, hook rate, thumbstop rate, CVR, contribution margin, and other relevant metrics
* Scaling: Take proven creative and media-buying strategies and turn them into significant increases in profitable spend
* Funnels: Work on advertorials, landing pages, VSLs, offers, and other conversion assets to improve overall acquisition efficiency
* AI: Use AI aggressively to accelerate research, creative ideation, scripting, production, analysis, and workflows

**What Success Looks Like**
We don't measure activity; we measure results.
**This is a 100% performance role focused on scaling spend while maintaining CAC ceiling.**
**Success means:**

* Scaling paid spend while maintaining healthy unit economics
* Improving ROAS and reducing CPA
* Increasing creative win rate and testing velocity
* Finding new winning angles and audiences
* Improving conversion rates across the funnel
* Building a repeatable creative and media-buying system
* Ultimately, taking Fabula to the next level

**You are**

* 4–6+ years of experience creating performance creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands or eCommerce agencies (not B2B, not a generalist)
* A proven Meta media buyer who has personally scaled campaigns, not just overseen them (at least $200k/month in ad spend)
* Equally strong on creative strategy and performance marketing
* Deeply experienced with direct-response advertising and customer psychology
* Able to look at an ad account, creative performance, and funnel data and immediately identify what needs to change
* Experienced scaling DTC/eCommerce brands - not B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or general marketing
* Hands-on with creative: you can write or heavily edit hooks, scripts, headlines, briefs, and landing page copy
* Experienced managing creative production with UGC creators, editors, and designers
* An operator, not a consultant. You don't just make recommendations - you execute, test, learn, and scale
* Comfortable working directly with founders and taking significant ownership with minimal hand-holding
* AI-native: you use AI daily to accelerate research, creative development, analysis, and execution
* Fast-moving, highly analytical, and obsessed with finding what works

**Strong bonus points**

* Experience scaling supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or other DTC consumer brands
* Experience with advertorials, VSLs, or aggressive direct-response funnels
* Experience with TikTok Paid / Spark Ads
* Experience with Outbrain or Taboola
* Experience with tools such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Motion, Foreplay, or similar
* Strong understanding of FTC/FDA considerations for supplement advertising

**Important: Who this role is NOT for**
This is
**not**
a fit if:
  
  

* You've managed less than $200K/month in ad spend
* Your background is primarily organic social or influencer marketing
* You're primarily a creative strategist who doesn't understand media buying
* You're primarily a media buyer who relies on someone else for all creative strategy
* You've worked mainly in B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or non-eCommerce environments
* You're looking for a role where someone else tells you what to do

**We want someone who can walk into an eCommerce brand, look at the numbers and the creative, figure out what's broken, and start making it better immediately.**
**Schedule**

* Fully remote
* Full-time
* Minimum 6-hour overlap with US Eastern Time (10:00 AM–4:00 PM ET)
* Direct collaboration with the founders
* Significant ownership and autonomy
* Possible equity upside for strong performance

* Sólida trayectoria en iniciativas de Trade Marketing, producción de eventos para clientes y construcción de relaciones a largo plazo con socios de la industria.

title: Marketing Director

title: Senior Creative Manager
description:

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.
  
  
Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
  
  
Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.
  
  
Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
As a Senior Creative Manager, you will lead the development and execution of a 360° brand and creative strategy, shaping compelling concepts and delivering impactful campaigns across multiple customer touchpoints.
  
  
You will play a key role in strengthening brand identity, driving creative innovation and ensuring a consistent omnichannel experience. Combining strategic vision with hands-on execution, you will lead a team of creative professionals, bringing bold ideas to life while ensuring creative excellence across all channels.
  
  
**Creative Strategy & Brand Development**

* Develop and execute an integrated 360° creative strategy aligned with the brand's identity, positioning and business objectives.
* Act as a guardian of brand identity, ensuring consistency in creative direction, visual language, storytelling and tone of voice.
* Conceptualize and deliver innovative campaigns that strengthen brand equity, customer engagement and conversion.
* Translate brand strategy into compelling creative concepts, adapting content and messaging across different markets and channels.
* Stay ahead of emerging creative trends, bringing fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to brand communication.

**Omnichannel Campaigns & Creative Execution**

* Lead the development and execution of integrated campaigns across digital, e-commerce, CRM, visual merchandising and physical customer touchpoints.
* Ensure creative concepts are adapted effectively to each channel while maintaining a consistent brand experience and cohesive storytelling.
* Oversee creative assets across design, video, production, packaging, visual merchandising and digital experiences.
* Develop production briefs, manage creative shoots and collaborate with external production partners to deliver high-quality outputs.
* Partner with marketing, customer experience and commercial teams to align creative initiatives with business priorities.
* Review and approve creative outputs, ensuring brand consistency, quality and relevance across all channels.

**Creative Leadership & Project Management**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of creative professionals, fostering collaboration, innovation and accountability.
* Oversee creative workflows, project timelines, workload allocation and resource planning to ensure timely delivery.
* Balance strategic creative development with hands-on execution across multiple projects and campaigns.
* Drive creative excellence while establishing an efficient, collaborative and solutions-oriented working environment.

**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
Proven experience in developing and executing brand and creative strategies, including integrated 360° campaigns.
  
  

* A minimum of 4 years of managerial experience, with demonstrated ability to lead, motivate and develop creative teams.
* Strong omnichannel experience, with an understanding of how creative concepts translate across physical and digital customer touchpoints.
* Experience across multiple creative disciplines, including design, video, production, packaging, visual merchandising and UX.
* Strong conceptual thinking, storytelling and brand-building capabilities, with the ability to translate ideas into impactful creative outputs.
* Experience managing creative production, external agencies and multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to balance creative excellence with operational execution.
* Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and their application in enhancing creative output and efficiency.
* A collaborative, adaptable and proactive leadership style, with the ability to inspire teams and navigate a dynamic business environment.
* Experience within retail, hospitality, entertainment or creative agencies is an advantage. Exposure to consumer-facing brands and diverse creative environments is highly valued.

**Show Us Your Work**
A strong creative portfolio is an essential part of your application. Please include a link to your portfolio showcasing relevant creative work, including brand development, integrated campaigns and creative concepts you have brought to life.
  
  
We are particularly interested in understanding your creative contribution, the channels involved and how your ideas translated into execution.
  
  
**What We Can Offer You**
With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
  
  
We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
  
  
**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
  
  
**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**
It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.
  
  
We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

description:
**We’re VaynerMedia!**
VaynerMedia is a global integrated creative and media agency, built for today's consumers. As the Modern Agency of Record, it understands the nuances of today's attention landscape, empowering brands to win attention, drive relevance, and deliver business results. Founded in 2009, by Gary Vaynerchuk, the independently owned agency operates in 15 offices worldwide, including Amsterdam, Bangkok, Chicago, New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami, New York, Tokyo, Toronto, Singapore, and Sydney. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX family of companies
**.**
Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it. VaynerMedia EMEA is strong with a world-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time – PEOPLE. Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture.
  
  
**The PITCH.**
The
**Director of CAIT**
(Creators, Affiliates, Influencers, & Talent) helps oversee the EMEA CAIT team (priority markets UK & DE), reporting in to the VP of CAIT EMEA + dotted line into the SVP, CAIT @ VaynerX.
  
  
This role is a leader who goes beyond simple procurement to set the standard from the initial brainstorm through to the final assets, ensuring the department’s output is cast for relevance, directed for quality, and optimised for views, working hand in hand with our Creative department.
  
  
You will oversee the strategy and operations for sourcing diverse makers and talent to fuel our clients’ brand channels and beyond. You will bridge the gap between the CAIT team and the cross-functional team, ensuring that our external CAIT network is integrated directly into the AIM (Analyse, Ideate, Make) and PAC (Platforms, Algorithms, Culture) workflows to drive Production Excellence.
  
  
Leading a specific key account/s - driving efficiencies and proactive problem solving to deliver productions that joins the dots between cultural signals and relevance across SMA’S, CAIT, Production, Live Shopping, Experiential + incremental ideas.
  
  
**Here’s where you come in…**

* Collaboration: Partner with Client Partnerships, Strategy, and Creative leadership to architect CAIT-led campaigns. You will translate high-level brand concepts into casting strategies (diversity, volume, authenticity), ensuring we use CAIT profiles and partners to solve briefs and create ideas.
* Leadership: Train the team to proactively pitch CAIT-led concepts in sync with Creative to drive business results, moving the CAIT team from an "order taker" to a strategic partner, internally & externally.
* Quality Control: Define and enforce the standard for Excellence. Ensure the team understands the distinction between "Creator as Talent" (delivering raw performance/assets) and "Veditor" (technical assembly), ensuring delivered assets are creatively effective and commercially safe.
* Virtual Directing Protocols: Establish the frameworks and training for Modern Production empowering your team to guide creator talent toward the right performance metrics and optimisation.
* Mentorship: Manage and develop our CAIT team. Train them to think less like project managers and more like Casting Directors & Producers.
* Pipeline Management: Oversee the end-to-end operations of the CAIT pillars. While CAIT Managers handle day to day execution, you are accountable for the systems regarding contract negotiations, payment processing, and project timelines to ensure speed and compliance.
* Margin & Efficiency: Monitor the financial health of CAIT projects for EMEA. Optimise workflows to reduce rounds of revisions and ensure we are delivering high-volume assets at a margin that works for the business.
* Risk Management: Serve as the escalation point for CAIT negotiations or usage rights issues, protecting the agency and client from liability. The Subject Matter Expert: Serve as VaynerMedia’s internal authority on CAIT. Working closely with our internal Creative team, you are the person internal teams call to help sell a CAIT incremental scope to a hesitant client, and the person Strategy looks to for the latest on platform creator trends.
* External Representation: Represent VaynerMedia at industry panels, events, and new business pitches, articulating our unique "Creators as Talent" philosophy.
* Trend Analysis: Turn trends from the creator economy into actionable business opportunities for our clients.

We treasure
**Personality and Experience**
yet we do know that these qualifications lead to what
**WE KNOW**
as a success:
  
  

* 7-10 years of experience in social media, creative advertising, or talent management.
* Creative/Operator Hybrid: You have the taste level to improve a piece of creative work and the operational brain to manage the budget and timeline behind it.
* The Seller Mindset: You are comfortable in a room with clients, articulating the business value of creators and defending creative decisions.
* Practitioner Empathy: You understand the friction points of making content (because you’ve done it) and can build workflows that remove barriers for both the creator and the agency.
* Servant Leadership: You work for your team, not the other way around. You are responsible for creating an environment that fosters health, development, and inclusivity.
* Emotional Intelligence: You catch stress, fear, and anxiety in your team and convert it into practical optimism. When you need an outlet, you let it flow up, never down or across.
* Recruiting Partner: You actively partner with recruiting to support Vayner’s talent practices and build the best possible team.
* Clouds and Dirt: You are a practitioner who balances high-level strategy (clouds) with execution (dirt). You understand that the work matters, but how you get there matters even more.
* Social-First Lens: You are accountable for carrying out your role with a social-first mindset, ensuring all output meets the Vayner standard of excellence.
* Ownership: You take responsibility for actions and impact, pointing thumbs (at yourself) and not fingers (at others). You navigate the team through challenges without placing blame.
* Kind Candor: You deliver feedback that is clear, direct, fair, and empathetic. You view feedback as a gift and a catalyst for personal growth.
* Persuasion & Clarity: You can lead complex conversations and presentations at a moment’s notice, delivering messages in a clear, authentic way to get buy-in from stakeholders.
* Navigating Difficulty: You prioritise and navigate difficult conversations effectively, setting the example for the team.
* "Yes, And": You practice a mindset where all voices are valuable. You view challenges as opportunities to create something better.
* Change Management: You help guide teams through change, collaborating with senior levels to share what’s working and accelerate growth across the company.
* Risk Taking: You identify opportunities for junior team members to take risks and give them the permission to challenge themselves.

**Here’s How We Support You**
We regularly review our benefits and are committed to providing a comprehensive programme for our people. Here’s what we have to offer:
  
  

* Unlimited Holiday + 1 Day Birthday Leave
* YuLife (online discount platform)
* Enhanced Parental Leave
* Unlimited Coaching sessions, which can be private and team class sessions
* Cycle to work scheme
* Employee Assistance Program (Financial, Mental and Physical Wellbeing)
* Cash Plan with Medicash - Level 1 cover, option to add partner, 4 children can be added for free
* Virtual GP, Skinvision, 24/7 Health and Stress Helplines, Discounted Gym, Medicash Extras
* 2 weeks Work From Anywhere
* Life Assurance
* Income Protection
* Group Personal Pension

**What You SHOULD KNOW About VaynerMedia**
Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!
  
  
We believe 100% that brands can be built on digital platforms and part of our model is built bottom up, flipping the traditional advertising model and process on its head. We don’t play to agency/industry norms and our culture and energy reflects that.
  
  
Our environment (and pace) feels much more like a start-up than most agencies you might be used to. Hopefully that, and the opportunity to collaborate with the talented and enthusiastic crew, work with big brands excites you, as it does us. We can’t wait to meet you.
  
  
VaynerMedia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This means that VaynerMedia provides equal employment opportunities to all staff members and job applicants without regard to gender, pregnancy, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, disability, sexual orientation, religious belief, part time or fixed term employment, age or any other legally protected class.

title: Associate Director, Experience Design
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

**The Role**

Your role As an AI UX Designer at Kyndryl, you will lead the design activities that connect insight, imagination, and execution for the next era of computing. You aren’t just building interfaces; you are defining the mental models and interaction patterns that allow humans to collaborate seamlessly with autonomous agents. Join Kyndryl and gain the trust, autonomy and teamwork to help define what comes next for us, our customers and global industries as a whole. What you will do Humanize Complex Intelligence •Architect intentional journeys: You’ll lead user research to uncover pain points in the human-AI relationship, creating journey maps that turn the complexity of multi-step agentic reasoning into clarity for the end user. •Design for non-deterministic UI: You will move beyond static wireframes to create dynamic interaction patterns that handle AI latency, ambiguity, and error states gracefully, ensuring users always feel in control of the autonomous process. Choreograph the Collaborative Loop •Facilitate co-creation: Lead workshops and usability tests to balance desirability with feasibility, working closely with creative technologists and AI engineers to ensure the intelligence of the system matches the intuition of the user. •Master Human-in-the-Loop (HITL): Design the critical hand-off moments where an agent needs human validation, ensuring that transparency and trust are built into every automated workflow. Advocate for Inclusive Evolution •Champion ethical design: Advocate for accessibility and inclusive intelligence, ensuring that our AI experiences are equitable and work for all users across diverse backgrounds. •Shape the interface era: Maintain a strong perspective on how agentic AI drives human-centered design, using clear storytelling to inspire alignment across the full design lifecycle—from discovery to delivery.

Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of vaccination to align with their respective COVID-19 vaccination policies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •UX / experience design or a related field, with a strong portfolio of enterprise or innovation-studio projects •Deep understanding of user-centered design, interaction design, and usability testing methods •Comfortable facilitating co-creation sessions and presenting to clients •Direct experience with AI, agentic AI/UX and data-driven design is preferred •A POV on how AI can drive human-centered design and co-creation •Experience with emerging AI assistants (Figma Make, MiroAI, Adobe Firefly, Lovable, etc) •Fluent in Figma or Sketch, or similar prototyping tools •Experience working with developers / product managers to translate research into delivery •Excellent communication skills in English
